units.title: 之、以、哦
units.intro: HSK 7–9 · I, words 1–40, most common first. The sentences use characters from this unit and earlier ones, so each unit builds on the last. Finish the lessons, then pass the checkpoint (85%) to open the next unit.

items.en: (possessive particle, literary equivalent of 的); him; her

ex.zh: 我想在买之前先试试这个新机型。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng zài mǎi zhī qián xiān shì shì zhè gè xīn jī xíng
ex.en: I'd like to try out this new model before I buy it.

ex.zh: 我父亲有个习惯，早餐之前读报纸。
ex.p: wǒ fù qīn yǒu gè xí guàn zǎo cān zhī qián dòu bào zhǐ
ex.en: My father is in the habit of reading the newspaper before breakfast.

ex.zh: 你还以为我不需要那么做，不是吗？
ex.p: nǐ hái yǐ wéi wǒ bù xū yào nà me zuò bù shì ma
ex.en: You thought I didn't need to do that, didn't you?

ex.zh: 你还没到可以拿驾驶执照的年龄。
ex.p: nǐ hái méi dào kě yǐ ná jià shǐ zhí zhào de nián líng
ex.en: You're not old enough to get a driver's license.

ex.zh: 哪条路都可以去公园哦。
ex.p: nǎ tiáo lù dōu kě yǐ qù gōng yuán é
ex.en: You can reach the park by either road.

ex.zh: 我一直住这家酒店的哦。
ex.p: wǒ yī zhí zhù zhè jiā jiǔ diàn de é
ex.en: I always stay at this hotel.

ex.zh: 他迫不及待地想试一下他的新冲浪板。
ex.p: tā pò bù jí dài de xiǎng shì yī xià tā de xīn chōng làng bǎn
ex.en: He couldn't wait to try out his new surfboard.

ex.zh: 六岁及以上的小孩应该上学。
ex.p: liù suì jí yǐ shàng de xiǎo hái yīng gāi shàng xué
ex.en: Children of six and above should attend school.

items.en: not yet; did not; have not

ex.zh: 他昨晚都在工作，彻夜未眠。
ex.p: tā zuó wǎn dōu zài gōng zuò chè yè wèi mián
ex.en: He worked last night without taking a break.

ex.zh: 我们有许多未完成的事。
ex.p: wǒ men yǒu xǔ duō wèi wán chéng de shì
ex.en: We have so many things left to do.

ex.zh: 无论发生什么我都不会改主意的。
ex.p: wú lùn fā shēng shén me wǒ dōu bù huì gǎi zhǔ yi de
ex.en: No matter what happens, I won't change my mind.

ex.zh: 你计划去大学后主修什么吗？
ex.p: nǐ jì huà qù dà xué hòu zhǔ xiū shén me ma
ex.en: What do you plan to major in at college?

items.en: to feel; to move; to touch

ex.zh: 事情没能如他所愿让他感到失望。
ex.p: shì qing méi néng rú tā suǒ yuàn ràng tā gǎn dào shī wàng
ex.en: He was disappointed that things didn't turn out as he'd hoped.

ex.zh: 所有的客人都被她的好客感动了。
ex.p: suǒ yǒu de kè rén dōu bèi tā de hào kè gǎn dòng le
ex.en: All the guests were touched by her hospitality.

ex.zh: 你们两个做了什么有趣的事情呢？
ex.p: nǐ men liǎng gè zuò le shén me yǒu qù de shì qing ne
ex.en: What do you two do for fun?

ex.zh: 你记事情的能力并不比我好多少。
ex.p: nǐ jì shì qing de néng lì bìng bù bǐ wǒ hǎo duō shǎo
ex.en: You are no better at remembering things than I am.

items.en: standard; norm; principle; (literary) to imitate; to follow

ex.zh: 随着时间的推移，比赛增加了规则以使之更安全。
ex.p: suí zhe shí jiān de tuī yí bǐ sài zēng jiā le guī zé yǐ shǐ zhī gēng ān quán
ex.en: As time went on, rules were added to the game to make it safer.

ex.zh: 你必须遵守规则。
ex.p: nǐ bì xū zūn shǒu guī zé
ex.en: You have to follow the rules.

ex.zh: 不是所有的德国人都喜欢喝啤酒。
ex.p: bù shì suǒ yǒu de dé guó rén dōu xǐ huan hē pí jiǔ
ex.en: Not all Germans like to drink beer.

ex.zh: 他们说她是在德国出生的。
ex.p: tā men shuō tā shì zài dé guó chū shēng de
ex.en: They say that she was born in Germany.

ex.zh: 我的一个女性朋友喜欢跟我一起去同志酒吧。
ex.p: wǒ de yī gè nǚ xìng péng you xǐ huan gēn wǒ yī qǐ qù tóng zhì jiǔ bā
ex.en: A female friend of mine loves to go to gay bars with me.

ex.zh: 只是一场梦而已。
ex.p: zhǐ shì yī cháng mèng ér yǐ
ex.en: It's just a dream.

ex.zh: 只是感冒而已。
ex.p: zhǐ shì gǎn mào ér yǐ
ex.en: It's just a cold.

ex.zh: 学中文的学生只有他们几个。
ex.p: xué zhōng wén de xué sheng zhǐ yǒu tā men jī gè
ex.en: They are the only students who study Chinese.

ex.zh: 我上周开始学中文了。
ex.p: wǒ shàng zhōu kāi shǐ xué zhōng wén le
ex.en: I started learning Chinese last week.

ex.zh: 您这个年龄的人经常有这个问题。
ex.p: nín zhè gè nián líng de rén jīng cháng yǒu zhè gè wèn tí
ex.en: People your age often have this problem.

ex.zh: 她已经无法用语言表达她的感觉了。
ex.p: tā yǐ jīng wú fǎ yòng yǔ yán biǎo dá tā de gǎn jué le
ex.en: She was at a loss for words to express her feeling.

ex.zh: 天变暗了。我不知道是不是要下雨。
ex.p: tiān biàn àn le wǒ bù zhī dào shì bù shì yào xià yǔ
ex.en: It's getting dark. I wonder if it's going to rain.

ex.zh: 那个是我的。我不知道你的在哪里。
ex.p: nà gè shì wǒ de wǒ bù zhī dào nǐ de zài nǎ lǐ
ex.en: That's mine. I don't know where yours is.

ex.zh: 即使太阳从西边出来，我也不会改变主意。
ex.p: jí shǐ tài yang cóng xī biān chū lái wǒ yě bù huì gǎi biàn zhǔ yi
ex.en: Even if the sun were to rise in the west, I would not change my mind.

ex.zh: 我父母通常用法语对话，即使我母亲的母语是英语。
ex.p: wǒ fù mǔ tōng cháng yòng fǎ yǔ duì huà jí shǐ wǒ mǔ qīn de mǔ yǔ shì yīng yǔ
ex.en: My parents usually speak to each other in French, even though my mother is a native English speaker.

ex.zh: 你是唯一一个能帮助我们的人。
ex.p: nǐ shì wéi yī yī gè néng bāng zhù wǒ men de rén
ex.en: You're the only one who can help us.

ex.zh: 你是我唯一可以信任的人。
ex.p: nǐ shì wǒ wéi yī kě yǐ xìn rèn de rén
ex.en: You're the only person I can trust.

ex.zh: 我是足球的忠实粉丝。
ex.p: wǒ shì zú qiú de zhōng shí fěn sī
ex.en: I'm a big football fan.

ex.zh: 情况丝毫没有改变。
ex.p: qíng kuàng sī háo méi yǒu gǎi biàn
ex.en: The situation hasn't changed at all.

ex.zh: 她就是所谓的书虫。
ex.p: tā jiù shì suǒ wèi de shū chóng
ex.en: She is what we call a bookworm.

ex.zh: 所谓陌生人，只是还未相见的友人而已。
ex.p: suǒ wèi mò shēng rén zhǐ shì hái wèi xiāng jiàn de yǒu rén ér yǐ
ex.en: A stranger is just a friend you haven't met yet.

ex.zh: 警察会调查这起案件。
ex.p: jǐng chá huì diào chá zhè qǐ àn jiàn
ex.en: The police will look into the case.

ex.zh: 我从没读过那么恐怖的小说。
ex.p: wǒ cóng méi dòu guò nà me kǒng bù de xiǎo shuō
ex.en: I've never read such a scary novel.

ex.zh: 我痛恨恐怖主义组织。
ex.p: wǒ tòng hèn kǒng bù zhǔ yì zǔ zhī
ex.en: I hate terrorist organizations.

items.en: to require; to need; to want

ex.zh: 你还有什么事情需要我去做的吗？
ex.p: nǐ hái yǒu shén me shì qing xū yào wǒ qù zuò de ma
ex.en: Is there anything else you want me to do?

ex.zh: 她需要一些钱来买点东西喂她的狗。
ex.p: tā xū yào yī xiē qián lái mǎi diǎn dōng xī wéi tā de gǒu
ex.en: She needed some money to buy something to feed her dog.

ex.zh: 我在找关于古罗马历史的书。
ex.p: wǒ zài zhǎo guān yú gǔ luó mǎ lì shǐ de shū
ex.en: I'm looking for books on Roman history.

ex.zh: 罗马不是一天建成的。
ex.p: luó mǎ bù shì yī tiān jiàn chéng de
ex.en: Rome wasn't built in a day.

ex.zh: 你应该去竞选城市委员会。
ex.p: nǐ yīng gāi qù jìng xuǎn chéng shì wěi yuán huì
ex.en: You should run for city council.

ex.zh: 委员会一个月召开两次。
ex.p: wěi yuán huì yī gè yuè zhào kāi liǎng cì
ex.en: The committee meets twice a month.

ex.zh: 价格已经达到了十三年以来的最高点。
ex.p: jià gé yǐ jīng dá dào le shí sān nián yǐ lái de zuì gāo diǎn
ex.en: Prices have reached a 13-year high.

ex.zh: 价格还会继续涨吗？
ex.p: jià gé hái huì jì xù zhǎng ma
ex.en: Will the price keep going up?

ex.zh: 跟上最近潮流时尚是件非常花钱的事儿。
ex.p: gēn shàng zuì jìn cháo liú shí shàng shì jiàn fēi cháng huā qián de shì ér
ex.en: It is very expensive to keep up with the latest fashions.

ex.zh: 你们这些家伙真不懂事。
ex.p: nǐ men zhè xiē jiā huo zhēn bù dǒng shì
ex.en: You guys are totally clueless.

ex.zh: 我想要大家伙帮我个忙。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng yào dà jiā huǒ bāng wǒ gè máng
ex.en: I want you guys to do me a favor.

items.en: attack (esp. surprise attack); raid; to attack

ex.zh: 我们被暴风雨袭击了。
ex.p: wǒ men bèi bào fēng yǔ xí jī le
ex.en: We were caught in a storm.

ex.zh: 我被他的故事感染了。
ex.p: wǒ bèi tā de gù shì gǎn rǎn le
ex.en: I was very impressed by his story.

ex.zh: 汤姆的笑声很有感染力。
ex.p: tāng mǔ de xiào shēng hěn yǒu gǎn rǎn lì
ex.en: Tom's laughter is infectious.

items.en: one by one; one after another

ex.zh: 你是唯一一个能帮助我们的人。
ex.p: nǐ shì wéi yī yī gè néng bāng zhù wǒ men de rén
ex.en: You're the only one who can help us.

ex.zh: 汤姆是唯一一个有相机的人。
ex.p: tāng mǔ shì wéi yī yī gè yǒu xiàng jī de rén
ex.en: Tom is the only one who has a camera.

ex.zh: 你相信有幽灵吗？
ex.p: nǐ xiāng xìn yǒu yōu líng ma
ex.en: Do you believe in ghosts?

ex.zh: 我丢了我的灵感。
ex.p: wǒ diū le wǒ de líng gǎn
ex.en: I lost my inspiration.

items.en: to smash; to pound; to fail

ex.zh: 有人把我新车的挡风玻璃砸碎了。
ex.p: yǒu rén bǎ wǒ xīn chē de dǎng fēng bō li zá suì le
ex.en: Someone smashed the windshield of my new car.

ex.zh: 令我非常伤心的是她考砸了。
ex.p: líng wǒ fēi cháng shāng xīn de shì tā kǎo zá le
ex.en: She failed the examination and I was greatly disappointed.

ex.zh: 最近的咖啡短缺带来了许多问题。
ex.p: zuì jìn de kā fēi duǎn quē dài lái le xǔ duō wèn tí
ex.en: The recent coffee shortage brought about many problems.

ex.zh: 我们还有许多别的事情要讨论。
ex.p: wǒ men hái yǒu xǔ duō bié de shì qing yào tǎo lùn
ex.en: We still have many other things to discuss.

ex.zh: 有些人害怕婚姻。
ex.p: yǒu xiē rén hài pà hūn yīn
ex.en: Marriage frightens some people.

ex.zh: 如果没有太阳，那所有生物都会死。
ex.p: rú guǒ méi yǒu tài yang nà suǒ yǒu shēng wù dū huì sǐ
ex.en: If there was no sun, all the animals would be dead.

ex.zh: 他是一个生物学家。
ex.p: tā shì yī gè shēng wù xué jiā
ex.en: He's a biologist.

ex.zh: 我不知道这个城市，而且我一点都不懂那里的语言。
ex.p: wǒ bù zhī dào zhè gè chéng shì ér qiě wǒ yī diǎn dōu bù dǒng nà li de yǔ yán
ex.en: I didn't know the city, and what's more, I couldn't speak a word of the language.

ex.zh: 他的演讲简短且切中要害。
ex.p: tā de yǎn jiǎng jiǎn duǎn qiě qiē zhōng yào hài
ex.en: His speech was short and to the point.

ex.zh: 我不推荐在那家餐馆吃饭。食物糟糕透了。
ex.p: wǒ bù tuī jiàn zài nà jiā cān guǎn chī fàn shí wù zāo gāo tòu le
ex.en: I don't recommend eating in that restaurant. The food is awful.

ex.zh: 你推荐我买哪个？
ex.p: nǐ tuī jiàn wǒ mǎi nǎ gè
ex.en: Which one would you recommend I buy?

袭.m: as in 袭击 (attack (esp. surprise attack))

units.title: 注、毫无、制
units.intro: HSK 7–9 · I, words 41–80, most common first. The sentences use characters from this unit and earlier ones, so each unit builds on the last. Finish the lessons, then pass the checkpoint (85%) to open the next unit.

items.en: to inject; to pour into; to concentrate

ex.zh: 我注意到她当时戴了顶新帽子。
ex.p: wǒ zhù yì dào tā dāng shí dài le dǐng xīn mào zi
ex.en: I noticed she was wearing a new hat.

ex.zh: 他们说了什么，我并不注意。
ex.p: tā men shuō le shén me wǒ bìng bù zhù yì
ex.en: I didn't pay attention to what they were saying.

items.en: not in the least; to completely lack

ex.zh: 没有爱情的生活毫无意义。
ex.p: méi yǒu ài qíng de shēng huó háo wú yì yì
ex.en: Life without love has no meaning at all.

ex.zh: 他说的话根本毫无意义。
ex.p: tā shuō de huà gēn běn háo wú yì yì
ex.en: What he says is total nonsense.

ex.zh: 他为他的迟到制造了一个借口。
ex.p: tā wèi tā de chí dào zhì zào le yī gè jiè kǒu
ex.en: He invented an excuse for being late.

ex.zh: 我的钱包是皮制的。
ex.p: wǒ de qián bāo shì pí zhì de
ex.en: My wallet is made of leather.

ex.zh: 这所学校为学生提供教科书。
ex.p: zhè suǒ xué xiào wèi xué sheng tí gōng jiào kē shū
ex.en: This school supplies students with textbooks.

ex.zh: 这家商店可以提供所有我们需要的东西。
ex.p: zhè jiā shāng diàn kě yǐ tí gōng suǒ yǒu wǒ men xū yào de dōng xī
ex.en: The store can supply us with anything we need.

items.en: to explore; to search out; to scout

ex.zh: 我们在探险的时候遇到了很多困难。
ex.p: wǒ men zài tàn xiǎn de shí hou yù dào le hěn duō kùn nan
ex.en: We encountered a lot of difficulties on the expedition.

ex.zh: 一名警探到达了犯罪现场。
ex.p: yī míng jǐng tàn dào dá le fàn zuì xiàn chǎng
ex.en: A detective arrived upon the scene of the crime.

items.en: (of a woman) to marry; to marry off a daughter; to shift (blame etc)

ex.zh: 她为了他的钱嫁给了他。
ex.p: tā wèi le tā de qián jià gěi le tā
ex.en: She married him for his money.

ex.zh: 我妹妹嫁给了一个医生。
ex.p: wǒ mèi mei jià gěi le yī gè yī shēng
ex.en: My sister married a doctor.

ex.zh: 所有的马都是动物，但并非所有的动物都是马。
ex.p: suǒ yǒu de mǎ dōu shì dòng wù dàn bìng fēi suǒ yǒu de dòng wù dōu shì mǎ
ex.en: All horses are animals, but not all animals are horses.

ex.zh: 他狼吞虎咽地吃了一顿。
ex.p: tā láng tūn hǔ yān de chī le yī dùn
ex.en: He devoured his meal.

ex.zh: 日本在某些领域赶上了美国。
ex.p: rì běn zài mǒu xiē lǐng yù gǎn shàng le měi guó
ex.en: Japan has caught up with America in some fields.

items.en: to watch attentively; to fix one's attention on; to stare at

ex.zh: 没人盯着她的时候，她甚至会哭。
ex.p: méi rén dīng zhe tā de shí hou tā shèn zhì huì kū
ex.en: She'll cry even when no one is looking.

ex.zh: 不要再这么盯着我了。
ex.p: bù yào zài zhè me dīng zhe wǒ le
ex.en: Stop staring at me like that.

ex.zh: 我听说你通过了入学考试。恭喜你了！
ex.p: wǒ tīng shuō nǐ tōng guò le rù xué kǎo shì gōng xǐ nǐ le
ex.en: I hear you passed the entrance exam. Congratulations!

ex.zh: 每个人都可能变成尸体。
ex.p: měi gè rén dōu kě néng biàn chéng shī tǐ
ex.en: Every man is a potential corpse.

ex.zh: 这就是发现尸体的房间。
ex.p: zhè jiù shì fā xiàn shī tǐ de fáng jiān
ex.en: This is the room where the body was found.

items.en: powder; cosmetic face powder; to turn to powder

ex.zh: 我的笔记本是粉色的。
ex.p: wǒ de bǐ jì běn shì fěn sè de
ex.en: My notebook is pink.

ex.zh: 面包是面粉做的。
ex.p: miàn bāo shì miàn fěn zuò de
ex.en: Bread is made from flour.

ex.zh: 他是一位著名的作曲家。
ex.p: tā shì yī wèi zhù míng de zuō qū jiā
ex.en: He is a famous composer.

ex.zh: 你为什么买这么多曲奇？
ex.p: nǐ wèi shén me mǎi zhè me duō qū qí
ex.en: Why did you buy so many cookies?

items.en: to set up; to put in place; (math.) given; suppose; if

ex.zh: 她想方设法以一己之力完成了工作。
ex.p: tā xiǎng fāng shè fǎ yǐ yī jǐ zhī lì wán chéng le gōng zuò
ex.en: She managed to finish the work on her own.

ex.zh: 这只是个假设。
ex.p: zhè zhǐ shì gè jiǎ shè
ex.en: This is just a hypothesis.

items.en: to push aside with the hand, foot, a stick etc; to dial; to allocate

ex.zh: 我想要一艘船带我远离这里。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng yào yī sōu chuán dài wǒ yuǎn lí zhè lǐ
ex.en: I want a boat that'll take me far away from here.

ex.zh: 这艘船太大，没法通过运河。
ex.p: zhè sōu chuán tài dà méi fǎ tōng guò yùn hé
ex.en: This ship is too big to pass through the canal.

items.en: bean vermicelli; mung bean starch noodles; Chinese vermicelli

ex.zh: 我是足球的忠实粉丝。
ex.p: wǒ shì zú qiú de zhōng shí fěn sī
ex.en: I'm a big football fan.

ex.zh: 你认为动物有灵魂吗？
ex.p: nǐ rèn wéi dòng wù yǒu líng hún ma
ex.en: Do you think animals have souls?

items.en: to suffer (from illness); to contract (a disease); misfortune

ex.zh: 我患上了重感冒。
ex.p: wǒ huàn shǎng le zhòng gǎn mào
ex.en: I'm suffering from a bad cold.

ex.zh: 昨天这家商店正好人满为患。
ex.p: zuó tiān zhè jiā shāng diàn zhèng hǎo rén mǎn wèi huàn
ex.en: The store happened to be crowded yesterday.

ex.zh: 她认出那枚胸针是她几个月前丢失的。
ex.p: tā rèn chū nà méi xiōng zhēn shì tā jī gè yuè qián diū shī de
ex.en: She recognized the brooch as the one she had lost a few months before.

ex.zh: 他拿出了几枚硬币。
ex.p: tā ná chū le jī méi yìng bì
ex.en: He took out some coins.

items.en: very early in the morning; in the wee hours
to rein in; to compel; to force

ex.zh: 中小企业要勒紧裤带才能存活。
ex.p: zhōng xiǎo qǐ yè yào lè jǐn kù dài cái néng cún huó
ex.en: Small businesses will have to tighten their belts to survive.

ex.zh: 他认为只有训练有素的演员才能够获得成功。
ex.p: tā rèn wéi zhǐ yǒu xùn liàn yǒu sù de yǎn yuán cái néng gòu huò dé chéng gōng
ex.en: He thinks that only very well trained actors can be really successful.

ex.zh: 我是素食主义者。
ex.p: wǒ shì sù shí zhǔ yì zhě
ex.en: I'm vegetarian.

items.en: another person; sb else; other people

ex.zh: 有些人喜欢排球，其他人喜欢网球。
ex.p: yǒu xiē rén xǐ huan pái qiú qí tā rén xǐ huan wǎng qiú
ex.en: Some people like volleyball, others enjoy tennis.

ex.zh: 他和许多其他人一样问了我同样的问题。
ex.p: tā hé xǔ duō qí tā rén yī yàng wèn le wǒ tóng yàng de wèn tí
ex.en: He asked me questions similar to those asked by many others.

items.en: to wash out; (fig.) to cull; to weed out
to release; to set free; to liberate (a prisoner)

ex.zh: 奥运会最重要的不是获胜，而是参与。
ex.p: aò yùn huì zuì zhòng yào de bù shì huò shèng ér shì cān yù
ex.en: The most important thing in the Olympic Games is not winning but taking part.

items.en: to let go; to cast; to let loose

ex.zh: 我认为这可以撒些盐。
ex.p: wǒ rèn wéi zhè kě yǐ sā xiē yán
ex.en: I think that it could use some salt.

ex.zh: 你可以向别人撒谎，但你不会向自己撒谎。
ex.p: nǐ kě yǐ xiàng bié ren sā huǎng dàn nǐ bù huì xiàng zì jǐ sā huǎng
ex.en: You can lie to everyone else, but you can't lie to yourself.

ex.zh: 旧村屋有它自己一定的魅力。
ex.p: jiù cūn wū yǒu tā zì jǐ yī dìng de mèi lì
ex.en: The old cottage has a certain charm about it.

ex.zh: 她是个有有魅力的女性。
ex.p: tā shì gè yǒu yǒu mèi lì de nǚ xìng
ex.en: She is a charming woman.

ex.zh: 我想我会一辈子单身。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng wǒ huì yī bèi zi dān shēn
ex.en: I guess I'm never going to get married.

ex.zh: 汤姆一直都是单身汉。
ex.p: tāng mǔ yī zhí dōu shì dān shēn hàn
ex.en: Tom has always been a bachelor.

ex.zh: 嘿，你的狗刚咬了我。
ex.p: hēi nǐ de gǒu gāng yǎo le wǒ
ex.en: Hey, your dog just bit me.

ex.zh: 嘿，看我找到了什么。
ex.p: hēi kàn wǒ zhǎo dào le shén me
ex.en: Hey, look what I found.

items.en: to groan; to snort; to hum

ex.zh: 我不相信他是真心的。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiāng xìn tā shì zhēn xīn de
ex.en: I don't think he is sincere.

ex.zh: 你应该用一下除臭剂。
ex.p: nǐ yīng gāi yòng yī xià chú chòu jì
ex.en: You should use a deodorant.

ex.zh: 发生这种情况的几率多大？
ex.p: fā shēng zhè zhǒng qíng kuàng de jī lǜ duō dà
ex.en: What are the chances of that happening?

ex.zh: 她是个很坦率的人。
ex.p: tā shì gè hěn tǎn shuài de rén
ex.en: She has a very open personality.

凌.m: as in 凌晨 (very early in the morning)

汰.m: as in 淘汰 (to wash out)

units.title: 半场、吻、主义
units.intro: HSK 7–9 · I, words 81–120, most common first. The sentences use characters from this unit and earlier ones, so each unit builds on the last. Finish the lessons, then pass the checkpoint (85%) to open the next unit.

items.en: half of a game or contest; half-court

ex.zh: 一等奖是公主的香吻。
ex.p: yī děng jiǎng shì gōng zhǔ de xiāng wěn
ex.en: The grand prize is a kiss from the princess.

ex.zh: 我看到了你在吻汤姆了。
ex.p: wǒ kàn dào le nǐ zài wěn tāng mǔ le
ex.en: I saw you kissing Tom.

ex.zh: 我痛恨恐怖主义组织。
ex.p: wǒ tòng hèn kǒng bù zhǔ yì zǔ zhī
ex.en: I hate terrorist organizations.

ex.zh: 你是个乐观主义者。
ex.p: nǐ shì gè lè guān zhǔ yì zhě
ex.en: You're an optimist.

ex.zh: 我父亲至今从未去过国外。
ex.p: wǒ fù qīn zhì jīn cóng wèi qù guò guó wài
ex.en: My father has never been abroad.

ex.zh: 我觉得你应该多花点时间在作业上。
ex.p: wǒ jué de nǐ yīng gāi duō huā diǎn shí jiān zài zuò yè shǎng
ex.en: I think you need to spend a little more time on your homework.

ex.zh: 对不起，我忘了作业这回事了。
ex.p: duì bù qǐ wǒ wàng le zuò yè zhè huí shì le
ex.en: I'm sorry, I forgot to do my homework.

ex.zh: 他问我，是不是知道她的电话号码。
ex.p: tā wèn wǒ shì bù shì zhī dào tā de diàn huà hào mǎ
ex.en: He asked me if I knew her telephone number.

ex.zh: 我想问他的电话号码是多少。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng wèn tā de diàn huà hào mǎ shì duō shǎo
ex.en: I want to ask him for his phone number.

items.en: to startle; to be frightened; to be scared

ex.zh: 他的突然出现，让我们都感到惊讶。
ex.p: tā de tū rán chū xiàn ràng wǒ men dōu gǎn dào jīng yà
ex.en: His sudden appearance surprised us all.

ex.zh: 医生发现了一些令人吃惊的事实。
ex.p: yī shēng fā xiàn le yī xiē líng rén chī jīng de shì shí
ex.en: Doctors have discovered some startling facts.

ex.zh: 你知道中央情报局的什么？
ex.p: nǐ zhī dào zhōng yāng qíng bào jú de shén me
ex.en: What do you know about the CIA?

ex.zh: 别告诉任何人我尿床了。
ex.p: bié gào sù rèn hé rén wǒ niào chuáng le
ex.en: Don't tell anyone that I wet the bed.

ex.zh: 汤姆是糖尿病患者。
ex.p: tāng mǔ shì táng niào bìng huàn zhě
ex.en: Tom's diabetic.

ex.zh: 钱币的价值取决于所使用的金属的重量。
ex.p: qián bì de jià zhí qǔ jué yú suǒ shǐ yòng de jīn shǔ de zhòng liàng
ex.en: The value of the coins depended on the weight of the metal used.

items.en: expression or emotion showing in one's eyes; meaningful glance; wink

ex.zh: 他会让你吃灰的。
ex.p: tā huì ràng nǐ chī huī de
ex.en: He will make you eat dirt.

ex.zh: 我的办公室在那幢灰色的六层楼的四楼。
ex.p: wǒ de bàn gōng shì zài nà chuáng huī sè de liù céng lóu de sì lóu
ex.en: My office is on the fourth floor of that gray six-story building.

ex.zh: 不要把我们的计划告诉任何人。
ex.p: bù yào bǎ wǒ men de jì huà gào sù rèn hé rén
ex.en: Don't tell anyone our plan.

ex.zh: 他们的计划对我来说很有意思。
ex.p: tā men de jì huà duì wǒ lái shuō hěn yǒu yì si
ex.en: Their plan sounds interesting to me.

items.en: abbr. for the Big Dipper constellation 星

ex.zh: 像男人一样战斗！
ex.p: xiàng nán rén yī yàng zhàn dòu
ex.en: Fight like a man!

ex.zh: 我会战斗至死。
ex.p: wǒ huì zhàn dòu zhì sǐ
ex.en: I'll fight to the death.

ex.zh: 我正忙著找公寓。
ex.p: wǒ zhēng máng zhù zhǎo gōng yù
ex.en: I'm busy looking for an apartment.

ex.zh: 我们租了公寓。
ex.p: wǒ men zū le gōng yù
ex.en: We rented an apartment.

items.en: to give birth; to reproduce; to produce

ex.zh: 他把他的财产传给了他儿子。
ex.p: tā bǎ tā de cái chǎn chuán gěi le tā ér zi
ex.en: He passed his property on to his son.

ex.zh: 这块手表产自日本。
ex.p: zhè kuài shǒu biǎo chǎn zì rì běn
ex.en: This watch is made in Japan.

ex.zh: 我们应该对人使用基因编辑吗？
ex.p: wǒ men yīng gāi duì rén shǐ yòng jī yīn biān jí ma
ex.en: Should we use genetic engineering on people?

items.en: revolution; revolutionary; to revolt (against sb or sth)

ex.zh: 这场革命已经带来了很多改变。
ex.p: zhè cháng gé mìng yǐ jīng dài lái le hěn duō gǎi biàn
ex.en: The revolution has brought about many changes.

items.en: official (in an organization or government); administrator

ex.zh: 这条裙子你穿着很合身。
ex.p: zhè tiáo qún zi nǐ chuān zhuó hěn gě shēn
ex.en: The dress fits you very well.

ex.zh: 他们都穿着制服。
ex.p: tā men dōu chuān zhuó zhì fú
ex.en: They were all dressed in uniforms.

ex.zh: 他正睡着，像个婴儿一样。
ex.p: tā zhēng shuì zháo xiàng gè yīng ér yī yàng
ex.en: He's sleeping like a baby.

ex.zh: 婴儿终于不哭了。
ex.p: yīng ér zhōng yú bù kū le
ex.en: The baby has finally stopped crying.

ex.zh: 你可以问在那里玩耍的小孩。
ex.p: nǐ kě yǐ wèn zài nà li wán shuǎ de xiǎo hái
ex.en: You can ask the child who's playing over there.

ex.zh: 我小时候常常独自玩耍。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎo shí hou cháng cháng dú zì wán shuǎ
ex.en: I used to play alone when I was a child.

items.en: to install; to place; to put

ex.zh: 不要把本末倒置。
ex.p: bù yào bǎ běn mò dào zhì
ex.en: Don't put the cart before the horse.

ex.zh: 那有点难以置信。
ex.p: nà yǒu diǎn nán yǐ zhì xìn
ex.en: That's a little hard to believe.

items.en: to say; to tell; to announce

ex.zh: 让我来告诉你我不赞成你的理由。
ex.p: ràng wǒ lái gào sù nǐ wǒ bù zàn chéng nǐ de lǐ yóu
ex.en: Let me tell you the reasons that I don't agree with you.

ex.zh: 请问您能告诉我那家餐馆在哪吗？
ex.p: qǐng wèn nín néng gào sù wǒ nà jiā cān guǎn zài nǎ ma
ex.en: Can you please tell me where the restaurant is?

items.en: to follow sb's tracks; to tail; to shadow

ex.zh: 狮子在跟踪它的猎物。
ex.p: shī zǐ zài gēn zōng tā de liè wù
ex.en: The lion is stalking its prey.

items.en: full moon; to hope; to expect

ex.zh: 我希望我们有更多时间呆在一起。
ex.p: wǒ xī wàng wǒ men yǒu gēng duō shí jiān dāi zài yī qǐ
ex.en: I wish we could spend more time together.

ex.zh: 我希望所有人都来帮我打扫房子。
ex.p: wǒ xī wàng suǒ yǒu rén dōu lái bāng wǒ dǎ sǎo fáng zi
ex.en: I want everyone to help me clean the house.

items.en: to provoke; to irritate; to vex

ex.zh: 我很抱歉给你惹来所有的这些麻烦。
ex.p: wǒ hěn bào qiàn gěi nǐ rě lái suǒ yǒu de zhè xiē má fan
ex.en: I'm sorry to cause you all this trouble.

ex.zh: 我不想再惹事了。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiǎng zài rě shì le
ex.en: I don't want to cause any more trouble.

items.en: in other words; that is to say; so

ex.zh: 这是你的布丁。
ex.p: zhè shì nǐ de bù dīng
ex.en: Here's your pudding.

ex.zh: 园丁后来发现就是凶手。
ex.p: yuán dīng hòu lái fā xiàn jiù shì xiōng shǒu
ex.en: The gardener turned out to be the murderer.

ex.zh: 我们听到所发生的事，感到很惊讶。
ex.p: wǒ men tīng dào suǒ fā shēng de shì gǎn dào hěn jīng yà
ex.en: We were astonished to hear what had happened.

ex.zh: 我对你不负责任的态度感到惊讶。
ex.p: wǒ duì nǐ bù fù zé rén de tài du gǎn dào jīng yà
ex.en: I am alarmed by your irresponsible attitude.

items.en: to find out; to learn of

ex.zh: 我是倒数第二个得知这个坏消息的。
ex.p: wǒ shì dào shǔ dì èr gè dé zhī zhè gè huài xiāo xi de
ex.en: I was the second to last person to hear the bad news.

ex.zh: 她成功地从他口中得知了真相。
ex.p: tā chéng gōng de cóng tā kǒu zhōng dé zhī le zhēn xiàng
ex.en: She successfully got him to tell the truth.

ex.zh: 汤姆想学拳击，但他妈妈觉得这太危险了。
ex.p: tāng mǔ xiǎng xué quán jī dàn tā mā ma jué de zhè tài wēi xiǎn le
ex.en: Tom wants to learn boxing, but his mother thinks it's too dangerous.

ex.zh: 汤姆握紧了他的拳头。
ex.p: tāng mǔ wò jǐn le tā de quán tou
ex.en: Tom clenched his fists.

ex.zh: 感觉这不会有个好结局。
ex.p: gǎn jué zhè bù huì yǒu gè hǎo jié jú
ex.en: I feel like this isn't going to end well.

ex.zh: 那是原创的想法。
ex.p: nà shì yuán chuàng de xiǎng fǎ
ex.en: That's an original idea.

ex.zh: 上帝创造了世界
ex.p: shàng dì chuàng zào le shì jiè
ex.en: God created the world.

items.en: unexpectedly; actually; to go so far as to

ex.zh: 我很惊讶，你竟然不知道他们结婚了。
ex.p: wǒ hěn jīng yà nǐ jìng rán bù zhī dào tā men jié hūn le
ex.en: I'm surprised that you don't know about their marriage.

ex.zh: 有志者事竟成。
ex.p: yǒu zhì zhě shì jìng chéng
ex.en: Where there's a will, there's a way.

units.title: 之所以、醒来、致
units.intro: HSK 7–9 · I, words 121–160, most common first. The sentences use characters from this unit and earlier ones, so each unit builds on the last. Finish the lessons, then pass the checkpoint (85%) to open the next unit.

items.en: (after a noun N and before a predicate P) the reason why N P

ex.zh: 大爆炸致死六人。
ex.p: dà bào zhà zhì sǐ liù rén
ex.en: The huge explosion killed six people.

ex.zh: 有时候口误对政治家来说是致命的。
ex.p: yǒu shí hou kǒu wù duì zhèng zhì jiā lái shuō shì zhì mìng de
ex.en: A slip of the tongue is sometimes fatal to a politician.

items.en: to roast; to bake; to broil

ex.zh: 谢谢你烤的美味蛋糕。
ex.p: xiè xie nǐ kǎo de měi wèi dàn gāo
ex.en: Thank you for baking this delicious cake.

ex.zh: 我喜欢烧烤食物。
ex.p: wǒ xǐ huan shāo kǎo shí wù
ex.en: I love barbecue.

ex.zh: 你唱歌像天使。
ex.p: nǐ chàng gē xiàng tiān shǐ
ex.en: You sing like an angel.

ex.zh: 你真是个天使！
ex.p: nǐ zhēn shì gè tiān shǐ
ex.en: You're an angel.

items.en: old age; very; eldest child in a family

ex.zh: 我怀孕四个月了。
ex.p: wǒ huái yùn sì gè yuè le
ex.en: I'm four months pregnant.

items.en: a burst; a fit; a peal

ex.zh: 有一阵从北边吹来的冷风。
ex.p: yǒu yī zhèn cóng běi biān chuī lái de lěng fēng
ex.en: There was a cold wind blowing from the north.

ex.zh: 我看这雨还会下一阵子。
ex.p: wǒ kàn zhè yǔ hái huì xià yī zhèn zǐ
ex.en: I don't think this rain will let up anytime soon.

items.en: even if; even though; right away
curtain or screen; canopy or tent; headquarters of a general

ex.zh: 夜幕降临时，孩子们回家了。
ex.p: yè mù jiàng lín shí hái zi men huí jiā le
ex.en: The children returned home at dusk.

ex.zh: 奥运会已经开幕了。
ex.p: aò yùn huì yǐ jīng kāi mù le
ex.en: The opening ceremony of the Olympics has already begun.

items.en: to be missing; to disappear; unaccounted for

ex.zh: 我们必须调查医生的失踪案。
ex.p: wǒ men bì xū diào chá yī shēng de shī zōng àn
ex.en: We have to look into the disappearance of the doctor.

ex.zh: 失踪的猫还没被找到。
ex.p: shī zōng de māo hái méi bèi zhǎo dào
ex.en: The missing cat has not been found yet.

items.en: to enforce a law; law enforcement

ex.zh: 汤姆没有注意到监控摄像头。
ex.p: tāng mǔ méi yǒu zhù yì dào jiān kòng shè xiàng tóu
ex.en: Tom didn't notice the surveillance camera.

ex.zh: 把手举起来！这是抢劫。
ex.p: bǎ shǒu jǔ qǐ lai zhè shì qiǎng jié
ex.en: Hands up! This is a robbery.

ex.zh: 你被抢劫过吗？
ex.p: nǐ bèi qiǎng jié guò ma
ex.en: Have you ever been robbed?

ex.zh: 这药创造了奇迹。
ex.p: zhè yào chuàng zào le qí jì
ex.en: The medicine worked marvels.

ex.zh: 这是一个奇迹。
ex.p: zhè shì yī gè qí jì
ex.en: This is a miracle.

ex.zh: 我的钥匙就是在这附近丢失的。
ex.p: wǒ de yào shi jiù shì zài zhè fù jìn diū shī de
ex.en: I lost my key somewhere around here.

ex.zh: 保险箱的钥匙在我这儿。
ex.p: bǎo xiǎn xiāng de yào shi zài wǒ zhèr
ex.en: I have the key to the safe.

items.en: classifier for houses or buildings; ridgepole (old)

ex.zh: 一个有名的建筑师造了这栋房子。
ex.p: yī gè yǒu míng de jiàn zhù shī zào le zhè dòng fáng zi
ex.en: A famous architect built this house.

ex.zh: 这栋楼里面有中央暖气系统吗？
ex.p: zhè dòng lóu lǐ miàn yǒu zhōng yāng nuǎn qì xì tǒng ma
ex.en: Is there central heating in this building?

items.en: to lead to; to trigger; to initiate

ex.zh: 我不想在恐惧中生活。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiǎng zài kǒng jù zhōng shēng huó
ex.en: I don't want to live my life in fear.

ex.zh: 我不会表现出恐惧。
ex.p: wǒ bù huì biǎo xiàn chū kǒng jù
ex.en: I'm not going to show any fear.

items.en: to chop; to cut down; to throw sth at sb

ex.zh: 他在花园里砍了一棵树。
ex.p: tā zài huā yuán lǐ kǎn le yī kē shù
ex.en: He cut down a tree in his garden.

ex.zh: 他砍了花园里的一棵树。
ex.p: tā kǎn le huā yuán lǐ de yī kē shù
ex.en: He cut down a tree in his garden.

items.en: to finish; to end; to complete
to pull; to tear; (of cloth, thread etc) to buy

ex.zh: 她在树枝上把自己的裙子扯烂了。
ex.p: tā zài shù zhī shǎng bǎ zì jǐ de qún zi chě làn le
ex.en: She ripped her dress on a branch.

ex.zh: 我不想被牵扯到这件事里。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiǎng bèi qiān chě dào zhè jiàn shì lǐ
ex.en: I don't want to be involved in that matter.

ex.zh: 你在监狱里呆了多久？
ex.p: nǐ zài jiān yù lǐ dāi le duō jiǔ
ex.en: How long were you in jail?

ex.zh: 你去过监狱吗？
ex.p: nǐ qù guò jiān yù ma
ex.en: Have you ever been in jail?

ex.zh: 没有你这个城市孤单又冷清。
ex.p: méi yǒu nǐ zhè gè chéng shì gū dān yòu lěng qīng
ex.en: This city is cold and lonely without you.

ex.zh: 我孤单的时候总会想起他。
ex.p: wǒ gū dān de shí hou zǒng huì xiǎng qǐ tā
ex.en: I always think of him when I'm alone.

items.en: to hold; to grasp; to support

ex.zh: 你还和你的高中同学保持联系吗？
ex.p: nǐ hái hé nǐ de gāo zhōng tóng xué bǎo chí lián xì ma
ex.en: Do you keep in contact with your high school classmates?

ex.zh: 恐怕就这点上，我和你持不同意见。
ex.p: kǒng pà jiù zhè diǎn shǎng wǒ hé nǐ chí bù tóng yì jiàn
ex.en: I'm afraid I differ with you on this point.

items.en: to ensure; to guarantee; to safeguard

ex.zh: 平等是由宪法保障的。
ex.p: píng děng shì yóu xiàn fǎ bǎo zhàng de
ex.en: Equality is guaranteed by the Constitution.

items.en: to roar; to howl; to shriek

ex.zh: 墨汁用作染料时会产生有趣的图案。
ex.p: mò zhī yòng zuō rǎn liào shí huì chǎn shēng yǒu qù de tú àn
ex.en: India ink produces an interesting pattern when used as a dye.

ex.zh: 他的衬衫被酱汁弄脏了。
ex.p: tā de chèn shān bèi jiàng zhī lòng zàng le
ex.en: His shirt was stained with sauce.

items.en: all; each and every; in all cases

ex.zh: 他的名字在这个地区人尽皆知。
ex.p: tā de míng zi zài zhè gè dì qū rén jǐn jiē zhī
ex.en: His name is known to everybody in this area.

ex.zh: 这首歌老少皆宜。
ex.p: zhè shǒu gē lǎo shǎo jiē yí
ex.en: People of all ages like this song.

ex.zh: 对其他人你应该和善一点。
ex.p: duì qí tā rén nǐ yīng gāi hé shàn yī diǎn
ex.en: You should be kind to others.

ex.zh: 她很善于砍价。
ex.p: tā hěn shàn yú kǎn jià
ex.en: She's good at bargaining the price down.

items.en: persons involved or implicated; party (to an affair)
to open one's mouth; to start to talk

ex.zh: 开口是银，沉默是金。
ex.p: kāi kǒu shì yín chén mò shì jīn
ex.en: Speech is silver, silence is gold.

items.en: gentle and soft; tender; sweet (commonly used to describe a girl or woman)

ex.zh: 这条路挺险恶。
ex.p: zhè tiáo lù tǐng xiǎn ě
ex.en: The road is very treacherous.

ex.zh: 只要好人袖手旁观，恶人就会得胜。
ex.p: zhǐ yào hǎo rén xiù shǒu páng guān ě rén jiù huì de shèng
ex.en: As long as good people do nothing, evil will triumph.

items.en: partner; companion; comrade; associate; to accompany

ex.zh: 她为我作钢琴伴奏。
ex.p: tā wèi wǒ zuō gāng qín bàn zòu
ex.en: She accompanied me on the piano.

ex.zh: 你想要伙伴吗？
ex.p: nǐ xiǎng yào huǒ bàn ma
ex.en: Do you want some company?

items.en: to throw; to toss; to fling

ex.zh: 他不会抛下落难的朋友不管。
ex.p: tā bù huì pāo xià luò nán de péng you bù guǎn
ex.en: He could not forsake his friend in trouble.

ex.zh: 她抛弃了她的孩子。
ex.p: tā pāo qì le tā de hái zi
ex.en: She abandoned her children.

items.en: to foreordain; to be bound to; to be destined to

惧.m: as in 恐惧 (to be frightened)

柔.m: as in 温柔 (gentle and soft)

units.title: 诉讼、脖子、夜晚
units.intro: HSK 7–9 · I, words 161–200, most common first. The sentences use characters from this unit and earlier ones, so each unit builds on the last. Finish the lessons, then pass the checkpoint (85%) to open the next unit.

ex.zh: 马倒下时脖子断了。
ex.p: mǎ dǎo xià shí bó zi duàn le
ex.en: The horse broke its neck when it fell.

ex.zh: 我的脖子还疼。
ex.p: wǒ de bó zi hái téng
ex.en: My neck still hurts.

ex.zh: 这是我度过的最好的夜晚之一。
ex.p: zhè shì wǒ dù guò de zuì hǎo de yè wǎn zhī yī
ex.en: It was one of the best nights I've had.

ex.zh: 那是一个安静的夜晚。
ex.p: nà shì yī gè ān jìng de yè wǎn
ex.en: It was a quiet night.

ex.zh: 董事会一致决定任命她为执行总裁。
ex.p: dǒng shì huì yī zhì jué dìng rèn mìng tā wèi zhí xíng zǒng cái
ex.en: The board unanimously decided to appoint her as CEO.

ex.zh: 她的生活很寂寞。
ex.p: tā de shēng huó hěn jì mò
ex.en: She lived a lonely life.

items.en: (main) hall; large room for a specific purpose; of the same clan

ex.zh: 下午六点半到帝国酒店的大堂找我。
ex.p: xià wǔ liù diǎn bàn dào dì guó jiǔ diàn de dà táng zhǎo wǒ
ex.en: Meet me at the lobby of the Imperial Hotel at 6:30 p.m.

ex.zh: 我家附近有一座教堂。
ex.p: wǒ jiā fù jìn yǒu yī zuò jiào táng
ex.en: There is a church near my house.

ex.zh: 我将水倒入了桶中。
ex.p: wǒ jiāng shuǐ dào rù le tǒng zhōng
ex.en: I poured water into the bucket.

ex.zh: 这桶装满了水。
ex.p: zhè tǒng zhuāng mǎn le shuǐ
ex.en: The bucket was full of water.

ex.zh: 他们就快从香港抵达了。
ex.p: tā men jiù kuài cóng xiāng gǎng dǐ dá le
ex.en: They are arriving here soon from Hong Kong.

ex.zh: 她在香港有很多朋友。
ex.p: tā zài xiāng gǎng yǒu hěn duō péng you
ex.en: She has many friends in Hong Kong.

items.en: to search; to look for; to seek

ex.zh: 他寻找一切可能的逃生途径。
ex.p: tā xún zhǎo yī qiè kě néng de táo shēng tú jìng
ex.en: He looked for every possible means of escape.

ex.zh: 我正在为我的妈妈寻找礼物。
ex.p: wǒ zhèng zài wèi wǒ de mā ma xún zhǎo lǐ wù
ex.en: I am looking for a present for my mother.

items.en: to reform and open to the outside world

ex.zh: 当我第一次回波士顿时，我真是孤独。
ex.p: dāng wǒ dì yī cì huí bō shì dùn shí wǒ zhēn shì gū dú
ex.en: When I first came back to Boston, I was really lonely.

ex.zh: 我不相信孩子能独自到东京。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiāng xìn hái zi néng dú zì dào dōng jīng
ex.en: I don't believe the child came to Tokyo alone.

items.en: judgment (by a court of law); to pass judgment on; to sentence

ex.zh: 法庭对他的谋杀罪名作出了无罪判决。
ex.p: fǎ tíng duì tā de móu shā zuì míng zuò chū le wú zuì pàn jué
ex.en: The court acquitted him of the charge of murder.

ex.zh: 汤姆下个星期一会被判决。
ex.p: tāng mǔ xià gè xīng qī yī huì bèi pàn jué
ex.en: Tom will be sentenced next Monday.

ex.zh: 口香糖粘到他的鞋子上了。
ex.p: kǒu xiāng táng nián dào tā de xié zǐ shǎng le
ex.en: Some gum stuck to his shoes.

ex.zh: 你头发上粘着什么东西。
ex.p: nǐ tóu fa shǎng nián zhe shén me dōng xī
ex.en: There's something in your hair.

items.en: to throw; to fling; to swing

ex.zh: 你需要甩掉几磅。
ex.p: nǐ xū yào shuǎi diào jī bàng
ex.en: You need to shed some pounds.

ex.zh: 相对于橙子，我更喜欢苹果。
ex.p: xiāng duì yú chéng zǐ wǒ gēng xǐ huan píng guǒ
ex.en: I prefer apples to oranges.

items.en: because of; on the basis of; in view of
to be grateful; to appreciate; thankful

ex.zh: 我真的很感激你所做的一切。
ex.p: wǒ zhēn de hěn gǎn jī nǐ suǒ zuò de yī qiè
ex.en: I really appreciate what you've done.

ex.zh: 我们真的感激他们的努力。
ex.p: wǒ men zhēn de gǎn jī tā men de nǔ lì
ex.en: We really appreciate their effort.

items.en: to apply (paint etc); to smear; to daub

ex.zh: 他让妹妹帮他涂他房间的墙。
ex.p: tā ràng mèi mei bāng tā tú tā fáng jiān de qiáng
ex.en: He had his sister help him paint the wall of his room.

ex.zh: 你能在我的背上涂些防晒霜吗？
ex.p: nǐ néng zài wǒ de bēi shǎng tú xiē fáng shài shuāng ma
ex.en: Can you put some suntan lotion on my back?

items.en: (of a child) obedient, well-behaved; clever; shrewd
to arrest; to apprehend; an arrest

ex.zh: 我看见他被警察逮捕。
ex.p: wǒ kàn jiàn tā bèi jǐng chá dài bǔ
ex.en: I saw him caught by the police.

ex.zh: 警方逮捕了嫌疑人。
ex.p: jǐng fāng dài bǔ le xián yí rén
ex.en: The police arrested the suspect.

items.en: in an instant; in a flash

ex.zh: 两国代表团在日内瓦会面。

items.en: to take risks; to take chances; foray

ex.zh: 要这么做，你需要冒险。
ex.p: yào zhè me zuò nǐ xū yào mào xiǎn
ex.en: In order to do that, you have to take risks.

ex.zh: 我们都在冒险。
ex.p: wǒ men dōu zài mào xiǎn
ex.en: We're all at risk.

ex.zh: 咱们现在走吧。要不咱们要迟到了。
ex.p: zán men xiàn zài zǒu ba yào bù zán men yào chí dào le
ex.en: Let's go now. Otherwise, we'll be late.

ex.zh: 要不我们找时间喝一顿。
ex.p: yào bù wǒ men zhǎo shí jiān hē yī dùn
ex.en: Perhaps we could get a drink sometime.

items.en: to appear; to emerge; to present (a certain appearance)
not to allow; to forbid; to prohibit

ex.zh: 嘴里有东西的时候不准说话。

ex.en: Don't talk with your mouth full.

ex.zh: 该名青年将少女从流氓团伙中救了出来。

ex.en: The young man saved the girl from a bunch of hoodlums.

items.en: to excuse sb; to exempt; to remove or dismiss from office

ex.zh: 有时候盟军无法避免战争。
ex.p: yǒu shí hou méng jūn wú fǎ bì miǎn zhàn zhēng
ex.en: Sometimes the Allies could not avoid battle.

ex.zh: 没有更多免费座位了。
ex.p: méi yǒu gēng duō miǎn fèi zuò wèi le
ex.en: There were no more free seats.

ex.zh: 这老人瞎了一只眼。
ex.p: zhè lǎo rén xiā le yī zhǐ yǎn
ex.en: The old man is blind in one eye.

ex.zh: 那狗一只眼是瞎的。
ex.p: nà gǒu yī zhǐ yǎn shì xiā de
ex.en: The dog is blind in one eye.

items.en: pit; depression; hollow; tunnel; hole in the ground; (archaic) to bury alive

ex.zh: 女孩给了我一枝红玫瑰和一枝白玫瑰。

ex.p: tā shǒu lǐ ná zhe yī duǒ méi guī
ex.en: She has a rose in her hand.

to kidnap; to abduct; to hijack

ex.zh: 那个孩子可能在回家的路上被绑架了。

ex.zh: 我被外星人绑架了。
ex.p: wǒ bèi wài xīng rén bǎng jià le
ex.en: I was abducted by aliens.

items.en: to entice; to lure; to induce

ex.zh: 看到这笔钱使他被诱惑偷东西。
ex.p: kàn dào zhè bǐ qián shǐ tā bèi yòu huò tōu dōng xī
ex.en: The sight of the money tempted him into stealing.

ex.zh: 我抵抗不了甜食的诱惑。
ex.p: wǒ dǐ kàng bù le tián shí de yòu huò
ex.en: I can't resist sweet things.

ex.p: tā shuō de méi yǒu yī gōu shí huà
ex.en: There isn't a grain of truth in what he says.

ex.zh: 实话说，我不赞成你。
ex.p: shí huà shuō wǒ bù zàn chéng nǐ
ex.en: Frankly speaking, I don't agree with you.

items.en: to be worried; to be distressed; worries

ex.zh: 今天是情人节

ex.en: Today is Valentine's Day.

items.en: to avail oneself of; to take advantage of

ex.zh: 趁你还年轻的时候，你应该尽可能经常地这样做。

ex.en: You should do that as often as you can while you're still young.

items.en: to be jealous of; to envy

ex.zh: 不要嫉妒其他人的成功。
ex.p: bù yào jí dù qí tā rén de chéng gōng
ex.en: You must not be jealous of others' success.

ex.zh: 他们嫉妒我们的成功。
ex.p: tā men jí dù wǒ men de chéng gōng
ex.en: They are jealous of our success.

ex.zh: 俄罗斯面临着严重的财政困难。
ex.p: é luó sī miàn lín zhe yán zhòng de cái zhèng kùn nan
ex.en: Russia is facing great financial difficulties.

ex.zh: 那些都是好迹象。
ex.p: nà xiē dōu shì hǎo jì xiàng
ex.en: Those are encouraging signs.

ex.zh: 汤姆日夜兼程。
ex.p: tāng mǔ rì yè jiān chéng
ex.en: Tom is on the go day and night.

ex.zh: 由医生来决定某人何时该死是对的吗？
ex.p: yóu yī shēng lái jué dìng mǒu rén hé shí gāi sǐ shì duì de ma
ex.en: Is it right for a doctor to decide when someone should die?

ex.zh: 早饭在何时何地用？
ex.p: zǎo fàn zài hé shí hé de yòng
ex.en: When and where is breakfast served?

ex.zh: 那个我以为诚实的男孩欺骗了我。
ex.p: nà gè wǒ yǐ wéi chéng shí de nán hái qī piàn le wǒ
ex.en: The boy I thought was honest deceived me.

to oversee; to take charge of; to supervise

ex.en: Hands up! This is a robbery.

ex.zh: 你被抢劫过吗？
ex.p: nǐ bèi qiǎng jié guò ma
ex.en: Have you ever been robbed?

ex.zh: 我们那时在谈论事情，但我不记得是什么了。
ex.p: wǒ men nà shí zài tán lùn shì qing dàn wǒ bù jì de shì shén me le
ex.en: We were talking about something at that time, but I don't remember what.

ex.zh: 我不想谈论这件事。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiǎng tán lùn zhè jiàn shì
ex.en: I don't want to discuss it.

items.en: regulations; rules; code of conduct; ordinances; statutes
to monitor; to keep a close watch over; surveillance

ex.zh: 汤姆往他的吐司上放了许多蜂蜜。
ex.p: tāng mǔ wǎng tā de tǔ sī shǎng fàng le xǔ duō fēng mì
ex.en: Tom put a lot of honey on his toast.

ex.zh: 汤姆往他的面包片上放了许多蜂蜜。
ex.p: tāng mǔ wǎng tā de miàn bāo piān shǎng fàng le xǔ duō fēng mì
ex.en: Tom put a lot of honey on his toast.

ex.zh: 我感到万分焦虑。
ex.p: wǒ gǎn dào wàn fēn jiāo lǜ
ex.en: I felt incredibly nervous.

ex.zh: 能不能麻烦你告诉我去邻村怎么走？
ex.p: néng bù néng má fan nǐ gào sù wǒ qù lín cūn zěn me zǒu
ex.en: Sorry, but can you show me the way to the next village?

ex.zh: 能麻烦您等一个小时左右吗？
ex.p: néng má fan nín děng yī gè xiǎo shí zuǒ yòu ma
ex.en: Can you wait about an hour?

ex.zh: 他是那个职位最有希望的候选人。
ex.p: tā shì nà gè zhí wèi zuì yǒu xī wàng de hòu xuǎn rén
ex.en: He was the strongest candidate for the position.

items.en: to be good at; to be expert in

ex.zh: 我不太擅长打高尔夫球。
ex.p: wǒ bù tài shàn cháng dá gāo ěr fū qiú
ex.en: I'm not very good at golf.

ex.zh: 这不是我所擅长的事。
ex.p: zhè bù shì wǒ suǒ shàn cháng de shì
ex.en: It isn't something I'm very good at.

items.en: to tie; bind or fasten together; to kidnap

ex.zh: 那女孩的头发上绑了一根黄丝带。
ex.p: nà nǚ hái de tóu fa shǎng bǎng le yī gēn huáng sī dài
ex.en: The girl wore a yellow ribbon in her hair.

ex.zh: 他们把小偷绑到了树上。
ex.p: tā men bǎ xiǎo tōu bǎng dào le shù shǎng
ex.en: They tied the thief to the tree.

ex.zh: 我们应该把那件事情告知他们。
ex.p: wǒ men yīng gāi bǎ nà jiàn shì qing gào zhī tā men
ex.en: We should inform them about that.

ex.zh: 他让我相信他是无辜的。
ex.p: tā ràng wǒ xiāng xìn tā shì wú gū de
ex.en: He convinced me of his innocence.

ex.zh: 他们都是无辜的孩子。
ex.p: tā men dōu shì wú gū de hái zi
ex.en: They're all innocent children.

ex.zh: 你需要甩掉几磅。
ex.p: nǐ xū yào shuǎi diào jī bàng
ex.en: You need to shed some pounds.

ex.zh: 真相可能比谎言更令人痛苦。
ex.p: zhēn xiàng kě néng bǐ huǎng yán gēng líng rén tòng kǔ
ex.en: The truth can be more painful than a lie.

ex.zh: 当他老板发现真相的时候，谎言给他带来了麻烦。
ex.p: dāng tā lǎo bǎn fā xiàn zhēn xiàng de shí hou huǎng yán gěi tā dài lái le má fan
ex.en: His lie got him into trouble when his boss discovered the truth.

items.en: to claim; to state; to proclaim

ex.zh: 她声称自己没罪。
ex.p: tā shēng chēng zì jǐ méi zuì
ex.en: She declared that she was not guilty.

ex.zh: 下午六点半到帝国酒店的大堂找我。
ex.p: xià wǔ liù diǎn bàn dào dì guó jiǔ diàn de dà táng zhǎo wǒ
ex.en: Meet me at the lobby of the Imperial Hotel at 6:30 p.m.

ex.zh: 不要再夸张了。
ex.p: bù yào zài kuā zhāng le
ex.en: Don't exaggerate.

ex.zh: 我们必须介入。
ex.p: wǒ men bì xū jiè rù
ex.en: We must intervene.

ex.zh: 我差点被卡车撞到。
ex.p: wǒ chà diǎn bèi kǎ chē zhuàng dào
ex.en: I almost got hit by a truck.

ex.zh: 他以优异的成绩毕业于剑桥大学。
ex.p: tā yǐ yōu yì de chéng jì bì yè yú jiàn qiáo dà xué
ex.en: He graduated from Cambridge with honors.

ex.zh: 筹划旅行的时候，我们必须考虑到全家人的意愿。
ex.p: chóu huà lǚ xíng de shí hou wǒ men bì xū kǎo lǜ dào quán jiā rén de yì yuàn
ex.en: We must take into account the wishes of all the family in planning a trip.

items.en: meritorious deed or service; achievement; result

ex.zh: 他们互帮互助，把校庆搞得很成功。
ex.p: tā men hù bāng hù zhù bǎ xiào qìng gǎo de hěn chéng gōng
ex.en: They helped one another to make the school festival a success.

ex.zh: 他本希望可以成功，但是他没有。
ex.p: tā běn xī wàng kě yǐ chéng gōng dàn shì tā méi yǒu
ex.en: He had hoped to succeed, but he didn't.

items.en: to lie on one's stomach; (Tw) percent

ex.zh: 她没有任何亲戚朋友照顾她。
ex.p: tā méi yǒu rèn hé qīn qi péng you zhào gu tā
ex.en: She doesn't have any friends or relatives to take care of her.

ex.zh: 我们村里所有的村民几乎彼此都是亲戚。
ex.p: wǒ men cūn lǐ suǒ yǒu de cūn mín jī hū bǐ cǐ dōu shì qīn qi
ex.en: Almost everyone in our village is related to one another.

items.en: to get to the intended location; to be in place; to be in position
to be a suspect (in a crime); to be suspected of

ex.zh: 汤姆想知道哪里能买到姜黄。
ex.p: tāng mǔ xiǎng zhī dào nǎ lǐ néng mǎi dào jiāng huáng
ex.en: Tom wanted to know where he could buy turmeric.

items.en: to cure; to restore to health; uplifting; heartwarming

ex.zh: 癌症如果在第一阶段被发现的话是很容易治愈的。
ex.p: ái zhèng rú guǒ zài dì yī jiē duàn bèi fā xiàn de huà shì hěn róng yì zhì yù de
ex.en: Cancer can be cured easily if it is found in its first phase.

ex.zh: 建筑物在地震中摇晃。
ex.p: jiàn zhù wù zài dì zhèn zhōng yáo huàng
ex.en: The buildings shook in the earthquake.

ex.zh: 桌子为什么这么晃？
ex.p: zhuō zi wèi shén me zhè me huǎng
ex.en: Why is the table so wobbly?

ex.zh: 我纳闷我为什么不该那样做。
ex.p: wǒ nà mēn wǒ wèi shén me bù gāi nà yàng zuò
ex.en: I wonder why I shouldn't do that.

ex.zh: 她感到闷闷不乐的。
ex.p: tā gǎn dào mēn mēn bù lè de
ex.en: She felt blue.

items.en: to jab; to poke; to stab

ex.zh: 她在他的背上戳了一下。
ex.p: tā zài tā de bēi shǎng chuō le yī xià
ex.en: She stabbed him in the back.

擅.m: as in 擅长 (to be good at)

戚.m: as in 亲戚 (a relative (i.e. family relation))

ex.zh: 市长否认收受了贿赂。
ex.p: shì zhǎng fǒu rèn shōu shòu le huì lù
ex.en: The mayor denied having taken a bribe.

items.en: to blockade; to seal off; to lock down
to give a name to; to dub; to christen

ex.zh: 他以他祖父的名字被命名。
ex.p: tā yǐ tā zǔ fù de míng zi bèi mìng míng
ex.en: He was named after his grandfather.

ex.zh: 样本不够纯净。
ex.p: yàng běn bù gòu chún jìng
ex.en: The sample isn't pure enough.

items.en: to assign; to entrust (a task); to give

ex.zh: 什么赋予了人生意义？
ex.p: shén me fù yǔ le rén shēng yì yì
ex.en: What gives life its meaning?

ex.zh: 我们缺氧时就会打哈欠。
ex.p: wǒ men quē yǎng shí jiù huì dá hā qiàn
ex.en: We yawn when we are short of oxygen.

items.en: to be witness to; witness; evidence

ex.zh: 汤姆见证了所有发生的事情。
ex.p: tāng mǔ jiàn zhèng le suǒ yǒu fā shēng de shì qing
ex.en: Tom saw everything that happened.

ex.zh: 汤姆有低血压。
ex.p: tāng mǔ yǒu dī xuè yā
ex.en: Tom has low blood pressure.

ex.zh: 汤姆有高血压。
ex.p: tāng mǔ yǒu gāo xuè yā
ex.en: Tom has high blood pressure.

items.en: to steal; to rob; to plunder

ex.zh: 很多书被盗了。
ex.p: hěn duō shū bèi dào le
ex.en: Many books have been stolen.

ex.zh: 我们走开的时候，房子被盗窃了。
ex.p: wǒ men zǒu kāi de shí hou fáng zi bèi dào qiè le
ex.en: Our house was robbed while we were away.

items.en: to distinguish; to discern; to identify; to recognize
the opposite sex; of the opposite sex; heterosexual

ex.zh: 医学的最新进展颇为显著。
ex.p: yī xué de zuì xīn jìn zhǎn pō wèi xiǎn zhù
ex.en: The recent advances in medicine are remarkable.

items.en: to open fire; to shoot a gun

ex.zh: 除了钢琴以外，还会玩什么乐器吗？
ex.p: chú le gāng qín yǐ wài hái huì wán shén me yuè qì ma
ex.en: Do you play any instrument other than the piano?

ex.zh: 当我进入那个房间的时候，她正在弹钢琴。
ex.p: dāng wǒ jìn rù nà gè fáng jiān de shí hou tā zhèng zài dàn gāng qín
ex.en: When I entered the room, she was playing the piano.

items.en: to slip away; to escape in stealth; to skate

ex.zh: 他很小心地溜出房间，以免惊醒她。
ex.p: tā hěn xiǎo xīn de liū chū fáng jiān yǐ miǎn jīng xǐng tā
ex.en: He crept out of the room very carefully to avoid waking her up.

ex.zh: 过去我们每个周末都去溜冰。
ex.p: guò qù wǒ men měi gè zhōu mò dōu qù liū bīng
ex.en: We used to go skating every weekend.

ex.zh: 我住在离波士顿不远的一个农场。
ex.p: wǒ zhù zài chī bō shì dùn bù yuǎn de yī gè nóng chǎng
ex.en: I live on a farm not too far from Boston.

ex.zh: 他全家都在农场工作。
ex.p: tā quán jiā dōu zài nóng chǎng gōng zuò
ex.en: All of his family work on a farm.

items.en: rock 'n' roll (music); to rock; to fall off

ex.zh: 她沉迷于摇滚乐。
ex.p: tā chén mí yú yáo gǔn lè
ex.en: She is absorbed in rock music.

ex.zh: 我不喜欢摇滚乐。
ex.p: wǒ bù xǐ huan yáo gǔn lè
ex.en: I don't like rock music.

ex.zh: 我在给魔鬼当辩护士。
ex.p: wǒ zài gěi mó guǐ dāng biàn hù shì
ex.en: I'm just playing the devil's advocate.

ex.zh: 我非常享受你的陪伴。
ex.p: wǒ fēi cháng xiǎng shòu nǐ de péi bàn
ex.en: I really enjoy your company.

ex.zh: 你已经有人陪伴了。
ex.p: nǐ yǐ jīng yǒu rén péi bàn le
ex.en: You've got company.

items.en: to open; to start; (computing) to enable

ex.zh: 他表现的像个疯子。
ex.p: tā biǎo xiàn de xiàng gè fēng zi
ex.en: He acted like a madman.

items.en: (sports) baseline; (sewing) under thread; spy; informer; plant

ex.zh: 小镇被暴风雨后的洪水摧毁了。
ex.p: xiǎo zhèn bèi bào fēng yǔ hòu de hóng shuǐ cuī huǐ le
ex.en: The town was destroyed by the flood after the storm.

items.en: to block sb's path; to obstruct; to flag down (a taxi)
to meet; to encounter; to come across
if only (sth were possible); I wish (that)

ex.zh: 但愿我是一个好歌手。
ex.p: dàn yuàn wǒ shì yī gè hǎo gē shǒu
ex.en: I wish I were a good singer.

ex.zh: 但愿我能找到在我的博客上屏蔽评论的办法。
ex.p: dàn yuàn wǒ néng zhǎo dào zài wǒ de bó kè shǎng píng bì píng lùn de bàn fǎ
ex.en: I wish I could figure out how to disable comments on my blog.

ex.zh: 你有个温馨的家庭。
ex.p: nǐ yǒu gè wēn xīn de jiā tíng
ex.en: You have a very nice family.

items.en: to speak in defense of; to argue in favor of; to defend

units.title: 幸好、香水、多余
units.intro: HSK 7–9 · I, words 561–600, most common first. The sentences use characters from this unit and earlier ones, so each unit builds on the last. Finish the lessons, then pass the checkpoint (85%) to open the next unit.

ex.zh: 你有多余的钥匙吗？
ex.p: nǐ yǒu duō yú de yào shi ma
ex.en: Do you have an extra key?

ex.zh: 还有多余的盐吗？
ex.p: hái yǒu duō yú de yán ma
ex.en: Is it too salty?

ex.zh: 货物毫无损坏地到达了。
ex.p: huò wù háo wú sǔn huài de dào dá le
ex.en: The goods arrived undamaged.

ex.zh: 他参加了奥运会。
ex.p: tā cān jiā le aò yùn huì
ex.en: He took part in the Olympic Games.

ex.zh: 他在看奥运会。
ex.p: tā zài kàn aò yùn huì
ex.en: He's watching the Olympics.

ex.zh: 罪犯没有放人质们走。
ex.p: zuì fàn méi yǒu fàng rén zhì men zǒu
ex.en: The criminal didn't let the hostages go.

ex.zh: 每年冬天，我的嘴唇都会干裂。
ex.p: měi nián dōng tiān wǒ de zuǐ chún dū huì gàn liè
ex.en: I get chapped lips every winter.

ex.zh: 你的嘴唇很漂亮。
ex.p: nǐ de zuǐ chún hěn piào liang
ex.en: You have beautiful lips.

items.en: to teach; to train; to admonish

ex.zh: 我希望汤姆已经吸取教训了。
ex.p: wǒ xī wàng tāng mǔ yǐ jīng xī qǔ jiào xun le
ex.en: I hope Tom has learned his lesson.

ex.zh: 他认为只有训练有素的演员才能够获得成功。
ex.p: tā rèn wéi zhǐ yǒu xùn liàn yǒu sù de yǎn yuán cái néng gòu huò dé chéng gōng
ex.en: He thinks that only very well trained actors can be really successful.

items.en: to force; to compel; to coerce; forced; compulsory

ex.zh: 你该结束这种愚蠢的行为了。
ex.p: nǐ gāi jié shù zhè zhǒng yú chǔn de xíng wéi le
ex.en: You must put an end to this foolish behavior.

ex.zh: 那是我说过的最愚蠢的话了。
ex.p: nà shì wǒ shuō guò de zuì yú chǔn de huà le
ex.en: That's the stupidest thing I've ever said.

ex.zh: 一个入室盗窃者趁我去旅游的时候闯入了我家。
ex.p: yī gè rù shì dào qiè zhě chèn wǒ qù lǚ yóu de shí hou chuǎng rù le wǒ jiā
ex.en: A burglar broke into my house while I was away on a trip.

ex.zh: 我们走开的时候，房子被盗窃了。
ex.p: wǒ men zǒu kāi de shí hou fáng zi bèi dào qiè le
ex.en: Our house was robbed while we were away.

items.en: to set; to set up; to install
to hurry; to rush; to run quickly

ex.zh: 她确实很漂亮，但她很自私。
ex.p: tā què shí hěn piào liang dàn tā hěn zì sī
ex.en: It is true that she is pretty, but she is selfish.

ex.zh: 我觉得她有点自私。
ex.p: wǒ jué de tā yǒu diǎn zì sī
ex.en: It seems to me that she is a little selfish.

items.en: to gather together, pool or collect; to happen by chance; to move close to

ex.zh: 我们所有人凑份子给老师买生日礼物。
ex.p: wǒ men suǒ yǒu rén còu fèn zǐ gěi lǎo shī mǎi shēng rì lǐ wù
ex.en: We all chipped in to buy our teacher a birthday present.

ex.zh: 你需要两个才能凑成一对。
ex.p: nǐ xū yào liǎng gè cái néng còu chéng yī duì
ex.en: You need two to make a pair.

items.en: to be on the alert; vigilant; alert

ex.zh: 不要放松警惕。
ex.p: bù yào fàng sōng jǐng tì
ex.en: Don't let your guard down.

items.en: to descend; to arrive; to come

ex.zh: 夜幕降临时，孩子们回家了。
ex.p: yè mù jiàng lín shí hái zi men huí jiā le
ex.en: The children returned home at dusk.

items.en: to cut off (a length); to stop; to intercept

ex.zh: 我斩钉截铁地拒绝了。
ex.p: wǒ zhǎn dīng jié tiě de jù jué le
ex.en: I flatly refused.

items.en: knee; (Internet slang) to kneel down (in admiration)

ex.zh: 他们抵御入侵者，保卫了国家。
ex.p: tā men dǐ yù rù qīn zhě bǎo wèi le guó jiā
ex.en: They defended their country against the invaders.

ex.zh: 汤姆从他的绘画本上撕下了一页。
ex.p: tāng mǔ cóng tā de huì huà běn shǎng sī xià le yī xié
ex.en: Tom ripped a page out of his sketch book.

ex.zh: 汤姆把这一页撕掉了。
ex.p: tāng mǔ bǎ zhè yī xié sī diào le
ex.en: Tom ripped out the page.

ex.zh: 汤姆真是个大笨蛋。
ex.p: tāng mǔ zhēn shì gè dà bèn dàn
ex.en: Tom is such an idiot.

ex.zh: 我的兄弟是个笨蛋。
ex.p: wǒ de xiōng dì shì gè bèn dàn
ex.en: My brother is an idiot.

items.en: cabin; the hold of a ship or airplane
to handle; to take care of; to punish
line of thought; way of thinking

ex.zh: 我没有一点退休的念头。
ex.p: wǒ méi yǒu yī diǎn tuì xiū de niàn tou
ex.en: I don't have the slightest intention of retiring.

ex.zh: 巨大的柱子遮住了视线，让人看不到湖。
ex.p: jù dà de zhù zi zhē zhù le shì xiàn ràng rén kàn bù dào hú
ex.en: A large pillar obstructs the view of the lake.

items.en: emptiness; void; abstract theory or guiding principles

ex.zh: 我从来没有见过谁像你这么虚伪的。
ex.p: wǒ cóng lái méi yǒu jiàn guò shéi xiàng nǐ zhè me xū wěi de
ex.en: I've never known anyone as hypocritical as you.

ex.zh: 我在海边捡了个漂亮贝壳。
ex.p: wǒ zài hǎi biān jiǎn le gè piào liang bèi ké
ex.en: I picked up a pretty shell at the seaside.

ex.zh: 蛋壳容易破碎。
ex.p: dàn qiào róng yì pò suì
ex.en: The shell of an egg is easily broken.

凑.m: to gather together, pool or collect

惕.m: as in 警惕 (to be on the alert)

units.title: 投降、巡逻、煎
units.intro: HSK 7–9 · I, words 601–640, most common first. The sentences use characters from this unit and earlier ones, so each unit builds on the last. Finish the lessons, then pass the checkpoint (85%) to open the next unit.

ex.zh: 汤姆甚至连怎么煎鸡蛋都不知道。
ex.p: tāng mǔ shèn zhì lián zěn me jiān jī dàn dōu bù zhī dào
ex.en: Tom doesn't even know how to fry an egg.

ex.zh: 我们早餐做了煎饼。
ex.p: wǒ men zǎo cān zuò le jiān bǐng
ex.en: We made pancakes for breakfast.

items.en: to continue; to follow after; to go on with

ex.zh: 如果我们不继续赶路，我们会迟到的。
ex.p: rú guǒ wǒ men bù jì xù gǎn lù wǒ men huì chí dào de
ex.en: If we don't keep walking, we'll be late.

ex.zh: 因为闹铃没有响，所以我继续睡下去了。
ex.p: yīn wèi nào líng méi yǒu xiǎng suǒ yǐ wǒ jì xù shuì xià qù le
ex.en: I overslept because my alarm didn't go off.

ex.zh: 我接种了流感疫苗。
ex.p: wǒ jiē zhǒng le liú gǎn yì miáo
ex.en: I had a flu shot.

ex.zh: 你知道怎么恢复已删除的文件吗？
ex.p: nǐ zhī dào zěn me huī fù yǐ shān chú de wén jiàn ma
ex.en: Do you know how to recover a deleted file?

ex.zh: 你的名字已经从名单删除了。
ex.p: nǐ de míng zi yǐ jīng cóng míng dān shān chú le
ex.en: Your name has been crossed off the list.

ex.zh: 他把身子靠在胳膊上。
ex.p: tā bǎ shēn zi kào zài gē bo shǎng
ex.en: He leaned on his elbows.

items.en: to conceal; to hide (a taboo subject); to cover up the truth
an assertion; to declare; to state

ex.zh: 我想撤回我之前的陈述。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng chè huí wǒ zhī qián de chén shù
ex.en: I would like to retract my previous statement.

ex.zh: 她大方地道歉。
ex.p: tā dà fāng dì dào qiàn
ex.en: She had the decency to apologize.

items.en: to take a step; to stride

ex.zh: 他迈着稳健的步伐登上了山丘。
ex.p: tā mài zhe wěn jiàn de bù fá dēng shǎng le shān qiū
ex.en: He was walking up the hill at a steady pace.

ex.zh: 仅三分之一的成员出席了会议。
ex.p: jǐn sān fēn zhī yī de chéng yuán chū xí le huì yì
ex.en: Only one third of the members turned up at the meeting.

ex.zh: 从上周三起，她一直缺席。
ex.p: cóng shàng zhōu sān qǐ tā yī zhí quē xí
ex.en: She has been absent since last Wednesday.

items.en: to approve of; to endorse; (vote) in favor

ex.zh: 在这件事上，我无法赞同你。
ex.p: zài zhè jiàn shì shǎng wǒ wú fǎ zàn tóng nǐ
ex.en: I cannot agree with you on the matter.

ex.zh: 我完全赞同你。
ex.p: wǒ wán quán zàn tóng nǐ
ex.en: I agree with you absolutely.

ex.zh: 我不知道他来这里的确切时间。

lines.p: wū yún shì xià yǔ de zhēng zhào

lines.p: wǒ tīng shuō tāng mǔ bèi bǔ le

lines.p: wǒ zhī dào zěn me shè xiàn jǐng

lines.p: tāng mǔ shuō tā lè yì zuò zhè shì

lines.p: jǐng chá miáo zhǔn le nà gè nán rén

items.en: to disturb; to annoy; to mix

ex.zh: 她用茶匙搅她的咖啡。
ex.p: tā yòng chá shi jiǎo tā de kā fēi
ex.en: She stirred her coffee with a teaspoon.

ex.zh: 那声音搅了我的美梦。
ex.p: nà shēng yīn jiǎo le wǒ de měi mèng
ex.en: My sleep was disturbed by the sound.

items.en: to confer; to bestow; to grant
to go against; to be contrary to; to violate

ex.zh: 你不该违背你的诺言。
ex.p: nǐ bù gāi wéi bèi nǐ de nuò yán
ex.en: You shouldn't break promises.

ex.zh: 汤姆是糖尿病患者。

ex.en: Tom's diabetic.

ex.zh: 事故差点让他丢了性命。

ex.en: The accident almost cost him his life.

items.en: to act the leading role (in a movie or a play); to star; lead actor
synchronous; to synchronize; to keep step with

ex.zh: 汤姆预料这会发生。

ex.en: Tom expected this to happen.

items.en: there is no need; why should
to provide (an asset) as security for a loan; to put up collateral
the most important; of chief importance

ex.zh: 已经不需要再伪装了。
ex.p: yǐ jīng bù xū yào zài wěi zhuāng le
ex.en: There's no need to pretend anymore.

ex.zh: 他气喘吁吁的。
ex.p: tā qì chuǎn yù yù de
ex.en: He was out of breath.

items.en: vile; nasty; of very poor quality

ex.zh: 恶劣的天气对他的健康带来了影响。
ex.p: è liè de tiān qì duì tā de jiàn kāng dài lái le yǐng xiǎng
ex.en: The bad weather affected his health.

items.en: to expel (a member of an organization); to fire (an employee)

ex.zh: 或许你就应该把汤姆开除掉。
ex.p: huò xǔ nǐ jiù yīng gāi bǎ tāng mǔ kāi chú diào
ex.en: Maybe you should just fire Tom.

ex.zh: 如果那个男人再犯一个错误，我就开除他。
ex.p: rú guǒ nà gè nán rén zài fàn yī gè cuò wù wǒ jiù kāi chú tā
ex.en: If that man makes one more mistake, I'll fire him.

ex.zh: 她把他从烂泥中拽出来了。
ex.p: tā bǎ tā cóng làn ní zhōng yè chū lái le
ex.en: She pulled him out of the mud.

ex.zh: 他发言完后，大家陷入了沉默。
ex.p: tā fā yán wán hòu dà jiā xiàn rù le chén mò
ex.en: When he finished speaking, everyone was silent.

items.en: to tremble; to shake out; to reveal

ex.zh: 如果有人把事情抖出来，我就麻烦了。
ex.p: rú guǒ yǒu rén bǎ shì qing dǒu chū lái wǒ jiù má fan le
ex.en: I'll be in trouble if the story gets out.

ex.zh: 我的手抖得太厉害，没法穿针了。
ex.p: wǒ de shǒu dǒu de tài lì hai méi fǎ chuān zhēn le
ex.en: My hands were shaking too much to thread the needle.

items.en: time and place; world of a particular locale and era; (physics) space-time
to decrease; to lose; to damage; to harm; (coll.) to ridicule; to deride

ex.zh: 我的车在事故中受到严重损坏
ex.p: wǒ de chē zài shì gù zhōng shòu dào yán zhòng sǔn huài
ex.en: My car was badly damaged in the accident.

ex.zh: 我们的员工正在争分夺秒地修理冰暴带来的损坏。
ex.p: wǒ men de yuán gōng zhèng zài zhēng fēn duó miǎo de xiū lǐ bīng bào dài lái de sǔn huài
ex.en: Our employees are working around the clock to fix the damage caused by the ice storm.

items.en: frost; white powder or cream spread over a surface; frosting

ex.zh: 今天早上下厚霜了。
ex.p: jīn tiān zǎo shang xià hòu shuāng le
ex.en: We had a heavy frost this morning.

ex.zh: 你不想涂防晒霜是你的问题，但是晒伤了不要来抱怨。
ex.p: nǐ bù xiǎng tú fáng shài shuāng shì nǐ de wèn tí dàn shì shài shāng le bù yào lái bào yuàn
ex.en: If you don't want to put on sunscreen, that's your problem. Just don't come complaining to me when you get a sunburn.

ex.zh: 今天早上我耳朵流血了。
ex.p: jīn tiān zǎo shang wǒ ěr duo liú xuè le
ex.en: My ear was bleeding this morning.

ex.zh: 我开始流血了。
ex.p: wǒ kāi shǐ liú xuè le
ex.en: I've started bleeding.

units.title: 八卦、是非、言论
units.intro: HSK 7–9 · I, words 761–800, most common first. The sentences use characters from this unit and earlier ones, so each unit builds on the last. Finish the lessons, then pass the checkpoint (85%) to open the next unit.

ex.zh: 他被卷进了是非中。
ex.p: tā bèi juǎn jìn le shì fēi zhōng
ex.en: He was involved in the trouble.

ex.zh: 他是非常有想像力的作家。
ex.p: tā shì fēi cháng yǒu xiǎng xiàng lì de zuò jiā
ex.en: He is a very imaginative writer.

ex.zh: 您吃不吃辣椒？
ex.p: nín chī bù chī là jiāo
ex.en: Do you want pepper on it?

ex.zh: 能在日本找到这样的大的院子实属罕见。
ex.p: néng zài rì běn zhǎo dào zhè yàng de dà de yuàn zi shí shǔ hǎn jiàn
ex.en: It's rare to find big yards in Japan.

items.en: to lose consciousness; to be in a coma; stupor

ex.zh: 汤姆正昏迷不醒。
ex.p: tāng mǔ zhēng hūn mí bù xǐng
ex.en: Tom's out cold.

items.en: to work; to operate; to revolve

ex.zh: 这些机器目前不运转。
ex.p: zhè xiē jī qì mù qián bù yùn zhuǎn
ex.en: These machines aren't working now.

items.en: young and tender; (of food) tender; lightly cooked; (of color) light

ex.zh: 你觉得汤姆是不是太嫩了？
ex.p: nǐ jué de tāng mǔ shì bù shì tài nèn le
ex.en: Do you think Tom is too young?

items.en: to drift about; to wander; to roam

ex.zh: 我们在沙滩上起了火。
ex.p: wǒ men zài shā tān shǎng qǐ le huǒ
ex.en: We built a fire on the beach.

ex.zh: 我把我的手枪指向了目标。
ex.p: wǒ bǎ wǒ de shǒu qiāng zhǐ xiàng le mù biāo
ex.en: I aimed my gun at the target.

ex.zh: 他对一个生病的男人说这种事真是没良心。
ex.p: tā duì yī gè shēng bìng de nán rén shuō zhè zhǒng shì zhēn shì méi liáng xīn
ex.en: It was heartless of him to say such a thing to the sick man.

ex.zh: 还有什么比友情更好呢？
ex.p: hái yǒu shén me bǐ yǒu qíng gēng hǎo ne
ex.en: What is better than friendship?

ex.zh: 他们的友情深深地感动了我们。
ex.p: tā men de yǒu qíng shēn shēn de gǎn dòng le wǒ men
ex.en: Their friendship moved us deeply.

items.en: to offer for sale; to sell; to sell out; to betray

ex.zh: 一个真正的绅士不会出卖他的朋友。
ex.p: yī gè zhēn zhèng de shēn shì bù huì chū mài tā de péng you
ex.en: A true gentleman never betrays his friends.

ex.zh: 魔术师吸引了孩子们的注意。
ex.p: mó shù shī xī yǐn le hái zi men de zhù yì
ex.en: The magician had the children's attention.

ex.zh: 汤姆是个专业的魔术师。
ex.p: tāng mǔ shì gè zhuān yè de mó shù shī
ex.en: Tom is a professional magician.

ex.zh: 她一直和她的兄弟争吵。
ex.p: tā yī zhí hé tā de xiōng dì zhēng chǎo
ex.en: She was always quarreling with her brothers.

ex.zh: 他们争吵后，一周都没有再说话。
ex.p: tā men zhēng chǎo hòu yī zhōu dōu méi yǒu zài shuō huà
ex.en: After they argued, they didn't speak to each other for a week.

items.en: to stand out from the masses (idiom)

ex.zh: 汤姆有什么很与众不同的地方吗？
ex.p: tāng mǔ yǒu shén me hěn yǔ zhòng bù tóng de dì fāng ma
ex.en: What's so special about Tom?

ex.zh: 我以前总认为汤姆是有一些与众不同的。
ex.p: wǒ yǐ qián zǒng rèn wéi tāng mǔ shì yǒu yī xiē yǔ zhòng bù tóng de
ex.en: I always thought that Tom was a bit different.

ex.zh: 我把咖啡倒翻在地毯上了。
ex.p: wǒ bǎ kā fēi dào fān zài dì tǎn shǎng le
ex.en: I spilled my coffee on the carpet.

ex.zh: 狗在地毯上睡觉。
ex.p: gǒu zài dì tǎn shǎng shuì jiào
ex.en: The dog was sleeping on the mat.

ex.zh: 过去，我父亲常常喝酒直到深夜。
ex.p: guò qù wǒ fù qīn cháng cháng hē jiǔ zhí dào shēn yè
ex.en: My father used to drink till late at night.

items.en: to pass through; to penetrate; by means of

ex.zh: 这个公司二分之三的雇员是工程师。
ex.p: zhè gè gōng sī èr fēn zhī sān de gù yuán shì gōng chéng shī
ex.en: Two thirds of the employees of this company are engineers.

ex.zh: 你们不能解雇我们。
ex.p: nǐ men bù néng jiě gù wǒ men
ex.en: You can't fire us.

ex.zh: 我总觉得木偶戏有点吓人。
ex.p: wǒ zǒng jué de mù ǒu xì yǒu diǎn xià rén
ex.en: I always find puppet shows a bit creepy.

items.en: rays of light; brilliant rays; radiance

ex.zh: 孩子们非常喜欢在海滩上玩耍。
ex.p: hái zi men fēi cháng xǐ huan zài hǎi tān shǎng wán shuǎ
ex.en: Children really like playing on the beach.

ex.zh: 我在海滩上发现了一个漂亮的贝壳。
ex.p: wǒ zài hǎi tān shǎng fā xiàn le yī gè piào liang de bèi ké
ex.en: I found a beautiful shell on the shore.

ex.zh: 我们做这事没有额外报酬。
ex.p: wǒ men zuò zhè shì méi yǒu é wài bào chou
ex.en: We won't get paid extra for doing this.

ex.zh: 电池要额外付钱。
ex.p: diàn chí yào é wài fù qián
ex.en: You need to pay extra for the batteries.

items.en: to constrain or repress emotions; oppressive; stifling

ex.zh: 汤姆没法压抑自己的怒火了。
ex.p: tāng mǔ méi fǎ yā yì zì jǐ de nù huǒ le
ex.en: Tom couldn't hold back his anger.

ex.zh: 我的钥匙就是在这附近丢失的。
ex.p: wǒ de yào shi jiù shì zài zhè fù jìn diū shī de
ex.en: I lost my key somewhere around here.

ex.zh: 她认出那枚胸针是她几个月前丢失的。
ex.p: tā rèn chū nà méi xiōng zhēn shì tā jī gè yuè qián diū shī de
ex.en: She recognized the brooch as the one she had lost a few months before.

芒.m: as in 光芒 (rays of light)

to begin; to open; to start
to put up with; to tolerate

ex.zh: 你能容忍他做事的方式么？
ex.p: nǐ néng róng rěn tā zuò shì de fāng shì me

ex.zh: 章鱼小丸子真的很美味！
ex.p: zhāng yú xiǎo wán zǐ zhēn de hěn měi wèi
ex.en: Takoyaki is really quite delicious.

items.en: to believe firmly; without any doubt
to toss from side to side (e.g. sleeplessly); to repeat sth over and over again

items.en: early in the morning; at dawn

ex.zh: 我们有一些令人鼓舞的消息。

items.en: pocket; bag; to wrap up or hold in a bag

ex.p: wǒ pèi fú tā de yǒng qì

ex.en: You should set a good example for your children.

units.title: 妨碍、以免、恶意
units.intro: HSK 7–9 · I, words 841–880, most common first. The sentences use characters from this unit and earlier ones, so each unit builds on the last. Finish the lessons, then pass the checkpoint (85%) to open the next unit.

ex.zh: 暴风妨碍了我们准时到达。
ex.p: bào fēng fáng ài le wǒ men zhǔn shí dào dá
ex.en: The storm prevented us from arriving on time.

ex.zh: 罢工妨碍了国家经济。
ex.p: bà gōng fáng ài le guó jiā jīng jì
ex.en: The strike affected the nation's economy.

items.en: in order to avoid; so as not to

ex.zh: 他很小心地溜出房间，以免惊醒她。
ex.p: tā hěn xiǎo xīn de liū chū fáng jiān yǐ miǎn jīng xǐng tā
ex.en: He crept out of the room very carefully to avoid waking her up.

items.en: to hope for; to long for; to expect
to do what one is told; obedient

ex.zh: 汤姆的上司真的非常生气。
ex.p: tāng mǔ de shàng si zhēn de fēi cháng shēng qì
ex.en: Tom's boss was really angry.

ex.zh: 如果你有上司的话，学会尊敬他（她）。
ex.p: rú guǒ nǐ yǒu shàng si de huà xué huì zūn jìng tā tā
ex.en: Be respectful to your superiors, if you have any.

ex.zh: 这是我们的荣幸。
ex.p: zhè shì wǒ men de róng xìng
ex.en: It's our pleasure.

ex.zh: 我该买多少蜂蜜？
ex.p: wǒ gāi mǎi duō shǎo fēng mì
ex.en: How much honey should I buy?

ex.zh: 汤姆往他的吐司上放了许多蜂蜜。
ex.p: tāng mǔ wǎng tā de tǔ sī shǎng fàng le xǔ duō fēng mì
ex.en: Tom put a lot of honey on his toast.

ex.zh: 那是人类第一次在月球上行走。
ex.p: nà shì rén lèi dì yī cì zài yuè qiú shǎng xíng zǒu
ex.en: That was the first time that a man walked on the moon.

ex.zh: 你可以想象在月球上行走吗？
ex.p: nǐ kě yǐ xiǎng xiàng zài yuè qiú shǎng xíng zǒu ma
ex.en: Can you imagine walking on the moon?

items.en: roar of laughter (onom.); hubbub; to roar (as a crowd)
to lie; to tell an untruth

ex.zh: 会为你说谎的人，就会对你说谎。
ex.p: huì wèi nǐ shuō huǎng de rén jiù huì duì nǐ shuō huǎng
ex.en: People who will lie for you, will lie to you.

ex.zh: 父母教育他们的孩子说谎是不好的。
ex.p: fù mǔ jiào yù tā men de hái zi shuō huǎng shì bù hǎo de
ex.en: Parents teach their children that it's wrong to lie.

items.en: to recall; to recollect; to think back

ex.zh: 这让我感到沮丧。
ex.p: zhè ràng wǒ gǎn dào jǔ sàng
ex.en: It makes me feel sad.

ex.zh: 汤姆有点沮丧。
ex.p: tāng mǔ yǒu diǎn jǔ sàng
ex.en: Tom is a little depressed.

ex.zh: 在他倒下前我抓住了他的手臂。
ex.p: zài tā dǎo xià qián wǒ zhuā zhù le tā de shǒu bì
ex.en: I caught him by the arm before he could fall.

ex.zh: 马倒下时脖子断了。
ex.p: mǎ dǎo xià shí bó zi duàn le
ex.en: The horse broke its neck when it fell.

ex.zh: 观众人数庞大。
ex.p: guān zhòng rén shù páng dà
ex.en: The audience was very large.

items.en: to excavate; to explore; (fig.) to unearth

ex.zh: 水是液体。冻起来就成了固体。
ex.p: shuǐ shì yè tǐ dòng qǐ lai jiù chéng le gù tǐ
ex.en: Water is liquid. When it freezes, it becomes solid.

ex.zh: 一般而言，日本人很害羞。
ex.p: yī bān ér yán rì běn rén hěn hài xiū
ex.en: Generally, Japanese people are shy.

ex.zh: 你不需要害羞。
ex.p: nǐ bù xū yào hài xiū
ex.en: You have no need to be ashamed.

ex.zh: 汤姆往炖菜里加了西兰花。
ex.p: tāng mǔ wǎng dùn cài lǐ jiā le xī lán huā
ex.en: Tom added broccoli to the stew.

ex.zh: 人们说爱情是盲目的。
ex.p: rén men shuō ài qíng shì máng mù de
ex.en: They say love is blind.

ex.zh: 爱情是盲目的。
ex.p: ài qíng shì máng mù de
ex.en: Love is blind.

ex.zh: 他的急脾气迟早会惹祸上身。
ex.p: tā de jí pí qi chí zǎo huì rě huò shǎng shēn
ex.en: His quick temper will get him in trouble one day.

ex.zh: 他迟早会回来的。
ex.p: tā chí zǎo huì huí lai de
ex.en: He will come back sooner or later.

ex.zh: 没人解得了这个谜题。
ex.p: méi rén xiè dé le zhè gè mèi tí
ex.en: No one could solve the puzzle.

ex.zh: 你解开谜团了吗？
ex.p: nǐ jiě kāi mí tuán le ma
ex.en: Have you worked the puzzle out?

items.en: sufficient; full; to fill; to serve as; to act as

ex.zh: 小镇充满了活力。
ex.p: xiǎo zhèn chōng mǎn le huó lì
ex.en: The town was full of activity.

ex.zh: 您对我说的话有什么要补充的吗？
ex.p: nín duì wǒ shuō de huà yǒu shén me yào bǔ chōng de ma
ex.en: Would you like to add anything to what I've said?

items.en: to conceal from; to keep (sb) in the dark

ex.zh: 你是不是瞒着我什么？
ex.p: nǐ shì bù shì mán zhe wǒ shén me
ex.en: Are you hiding something?

ex.zh: 我常常能分辨出来一个人是不是瞒着我什么事情。
ex.p: wǒ cháng cháng néng fēn biàn chū lái yī gè rén shì bù shì mán zhe wǒ shén me shì qing
ex.en: I can usually tell when someone is hiding something from me.

ex.zh: 公车最终停了下来。
ex.p: gōng chē zuì zhōng tíng le xià lai
ex.en: At last, the bus stopped.

ex.zh: 在公车上，一个陌生人和我说了话。
ex.p: zài gōng chē shǎng yī gè mò shēng rén hé wǒ shuō le huà
ex.en: A stranger spoke to me on the bus.

units.title: 步伐、宽容、美人

ex.p: wǒ men yīng gāi zǒu chū shén me yàng de bù fá

ex.zh: 我们真的得加紧步伐了。
ex.p: wǒ men zhēn de de jiā jǐn bù fá le
ex.en: We've really got to step on it.

ex.zh: 她是一位真正的美人。
ex.p: tā shì yī wèi zhēn zhèng de měi rén
ex.en: She is a real beauty.

ex.zh: 在去剧院的路上，我看到了一起车祸。
ex.p: zài qù jù yuàn de lù shang wǒ kàn dào le yī qǐ chē huò

ex.zh: 汤姆觉得他有机会在股市赚一大笔钱。
ex.p: tāng mǔ jué de tā yǒu jī huì zài gǔ shì zhuàn yī dà bǐ qián

ex.p: tā cháo zhe gǒu rēng le kuài shí tou
ex.en: He threw a stone at the dog.

ex.zh: 他朝着大狗扔了块石头。
ex.p: tā cháo zhe dà gǒu rēng le kuài shí tou
ex.en: He threw a stone at the big dog.

ex.zh: 我用浴室的体重计量了体重。
ex.p: wǒ yòng yù shì de tǐ zhòng jì liáng le tǐ zhòng
ex.en: I weighed myself on the bathroom scales.

ex.zh: 给我从浴室拿几条毛巾来。
ex.p: gěi wǒ cóng yù shì ná jī tiáo máo jīn lái
ex.en: Get me some towels from the bathroom.

ex.zh: 你做了个坏榜样。
ex.p: nǐ zuò le gè huài bǎng yàng

ex.en: You've set a bad example.

ex.zh: 不要那么幼稚。

to save; to remedy; to rescue
expansion; dilation; to expand (e.g. one's power or influence)

ex.en: For the time being, I must share this room with my friend.

ex.zh: 他反对种族歧视。
ex.p: tā fǎn duì zhǒng zú qí shì
ex.en: He's opposed to racial discrimination.

ex.zh: 没有爱情的生活毫无意义。

ex.en: Life without love has no meaning at all.

ex.zh: 他说的话根本毫无意义。

ex.en: What he says is total nonsense.

ex.zh: 这是什么气味？
ex.p: zhè shì shén me qì wèi
ex.en: What's this smell?

apart from this; in addition to this
to brake (when driving); to stop; to switch off

ex.zh: 除非他们事先修好刹车，我才会买车子。

ex.en: I'll only buy the car if they fix the brakes first.

ex.en: A great warrior radiates strength. He doesn't have to fight to the death.

ex.p: tāng mǔ shì gè hěn yǒu cái huá de zuò jiā
ex.en: Tom is a very talented writer.

ex.en: Tom has a very strong French accent.

ex.p: nǐ duì fù hé tàn shuǐ huā gě wù yǒu shén me liǎo jiě ma
ex.en: Do you know anything about complex carbohydrates?

to mate or marry; to match; matching

ex.p: wǒ wú fǎ rěn shòu tā ào màn de tài du
ex.en: I couldn't put up with her arrogant behavior.

ex.en: Would you mind if I shut the window? I have a slight cold.

ex.p: rú guǒ nǐ bù jiè yì de huà wǒ xiǎng yī gè rén dāi zhe
ex.en: I'd like to be alone if you don't mind.

to request help; to appeal (for help)

ex.zh: 你是向汤姆求助的人中的一员吗？
ex.p: nǐ shì xiàng tāng mǔ qiú zhù de rén zhōng de yī yuán ma
ex.en: Are you the one who asked Tom to help?

ex.zh: 汤姆没有能求助的人。
ex.p: tāng mǔ méi yǒu néng qiú zhù de rén
ex.en: Tom has no one to turn to for help.

ex.p: dāi zài yuán dì zhí dào wǒ zhǎo dào nǐ

ex.en: It is no use arguing with her.

ex.zh: 这是场有趣的辩论。
ex.p: zhè shì cháng yǒu qù de biàn lùn
ex.en: It was an interesting debate.

ex.zh: 汤姆不认为这是一个巧合。
ex.p: tāng mǔ bù rèn wéi zhè shì yī gè qiǎo hé
ex.en: Tom doesn't think this is a coincidence.

ex.zh: 可能只是巧合。
ex.p: kě néng zhǐ shì qiǎo hé
ex.en: It could be just a coincidence.

ex.zh: 他的性情古怪。
ex.p: tā de xìng qíng gǔ guài
ex.en: He's a strange character.

items.en: to stop; to resist; to obstruct

ex.zh: 我很疑惑为什么天气变冷的时候我会觉得很孤单。

ex.en: People need to stop hating.

ex.en: His advice is always very sensible.

ex.p: wǒ xū yào yī zhī qiān bǐ wǒ néng yòng nǐ de qí zhōng yī zhī ma
ex.en: I need a pencil. Can I use one of yours?

ex.zh: 这是一只钢笔还是铅笔？
ex.p: zhè shì yī zhǐ gāng bǐ hái shi qiān bǐ

ex.zh: 我在报纸上刊登了我的房子的广告。

ex.zh: 我不像我以前那么拖延了。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiàng wǒ yǐ qián nà me tuō yán le
ex.en: I don't procrastinate as much as I used to.

items.en: cold and detached towards sb; lack of regard; indifference

ex.p: jǐn liàng bié wàng diào rèn hé shì
ex.en: Try not to forget anything.

ex.zh: 我一天又一天地给她写信。
ex.p: wǒ yī tiān yòu yī tiān dì gěi tā xiě xìn
ex.en: I wrote her a letter every day.

items.en: to be weary of; to be fed up with; to be bored with

ex.p: wǒ yàn juàn le tā de lǎo xiào hua
ex.en: I was bored with his old jokes.

ex.zh: 我厌倦了我的工作。
ex.p: wǒ yàn juàn le wǒ de gōng zuò
ex.en: I am tired of my work.

to take effect; to go into effect
to pour liquid; to irrigate (using waterwheel); to water

skin; flesh; fig. close physical relationship

ex.zh: 英语是当今世界上一种非常重要的语言。

lines.p: nǐ bù míng bai liú chéng
lines.en: You don't understand the procedure.

lines.p: nǐ líng rén nán yǐ kàng jù
lines.en: You're irresistible.

lines.p: nǐ shì bù kě kàng jù de
lines.en: You are irresistible.

lines.p: wǒ men hái shi cuì ruò bù kān
lines.en: We're still vulnerable.

lines.p: jīn nián wǒ men huì yíng lì de
lines.en: We'll be profitable this year.

lines.p: tā yǒu hěn duō lì shǐ shū jí
lines.en: He has a lot of books on history.

lines.p: wǒ mǎi le yī zhǎn hěn jiù de dēng
lines.en: I bought an old lamp.

lines.p: tā men chū fā qù nán jí tàn xiǎn
lines.en: They went on an expedition to the Antarctic.

lines.zh: 地图上的蓝线代表河流。
lines.p: dì tú shǎng de lán xiàn dài biǎo hé liú
lines.en: The blue lines on the map represent rivers.

lines.zh: 你的新商店什么时候开张？
lines.p: nǐ de xīn shāng diàn shén me shí hou kāi zhāng
lines.en: When does your new store open?

exercises.zh: 一个绅士是不会做这种事的。
exercises.p: yī gè shēn shì shì bù huì zuò zhè zhǒng shì de
exercises.en: A gentleman wouldn't do such a thing.

exercises.zh: 你看起来确信汤姆需要这样做
exercises.p: nǐ kàn qǐ lai què xìn tāng mǔ xū yào zhè yàng zuò
exercises.en: You seemed convinced that Tom needed to do that.

exercises.zh: 他有很多历史书籍。
exercises.p: tā yǒu hěn duō lì shǐ shū jí
exercises.en: He has a lot of books on history.

exercises.zh: 你令人难以抗拒。
exercises.p: nǐ líng rén nán yǐ kàng jù
exercises.en: You're irresistible.
The blue lines on the map represent rivers.
exercises.why: 河流 hé liú: river

exercises.en: The snow will melt when the sun comes out.
exercises.why: 融化 róng huà: to melt; to thaw; to dissolve

exercises.en: I adapted the garage for use as a workshop.
exercises.why: 车间 chē jiān: workshop

exercises.en: We're still vulnerable.
exercises.why: 不堪 bù kān: cannot bear; cannot stand; utterly

exercises.en: His dress is that of a gentleman, but his speech and behavior are those of a clown.
a: 他衣着像个绅士，言行举止却像个小丑。
exercises.p: tā yī zhe xiàng gè shēn shì yán xíng jǔ zhǐ què xiàng gè xiǎo chǒu

exercises.en: When does your new store open?
a: 你的新商店什么时候开张？
exercises.p: nǐ de xīn shāng diàn shén me shí hou kāi zhāng

units.title: 付款、忍耐、削
units.intro: HSK 7–9 · I, words 1601–1640, most common first. The sentences use characters from this unit and earlier ones, so each unit builds on the last. Finish the lessons, then pass the checkpoint (85%) to open the next unit.

items.en: to pay a sum of money; payment

ex.zh: 我们会用银行转帐付款。
ex.p: wǒ men huì yòng yín háng zhuǎi zhàng fù kuǎn
ex.en: We will make the payment by bank transfer.

ex.zh: 我想用支票付款。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng yòng zhī piào fù kuǎn
ex.en: I'd like to pay by check.

items.en: to endure; to bear with; to exercise patience
to peel with a knife; to pare; to cut (a ball at tennis etc)
to level off; to root up

ex.zh: 汤姆正要为我们铲掉屋顶上的雪。
ex.p: tāng mǔ zhēng yào wèi wǒ men chǎn diào wū dǐng shǎng de xuě
ex.en: Tom is going to shovel the snow off the roof for us.

ex.zh: 汤姆握紧了铲子。
ex.p: tāng mǔ wò jǐn le chǎn zi
ex.en: Tom clenched the shovel.

items.en: to smash to pieces; to shatter

ex.zh: 蛋壳容易破碎。
ex.p: dàn qiào róng yì pò suì
ex.en: The shell of an egg is easily broken.

items.en: to eliminate; to remove; except for

ex.zh: 这是非常好的土壤。
ex.p: zhè shì fēi cháng hǎo de tǔ rǎng
ex.en: This is very good soil.

ex.zh: 土壤被雨水冲走了。
ex.p: tǔ rǎng bèi yǔ shuǐ chōng zǒu le
ex.en: The rain washed away the soil.

ex.zh: 全体销售人员通宵达旦地工作了一周。
ex.p: quán tǐ xiāo shòu rén yuán tōng xiāo dá dàn de gōng zuò le yī zhōu
ex.en: The entire sales staff has worked around the clock for a week.

ex.zh: 你该把你的值钱物品保存在一个安全的地方。
ex.p: nǐ gāi bǎ nǐ de zhí qián wù pǐn bǎo cún zài yī gè ān quán de dì fāng
ex.en: You should keep your valuables in a safe place.

items.en: to understand; to pay attention to; to take notice of
to have a high temperature; feverish; unable to think calmly
to resist; to boycott; to refuse (to cooperate)

ex.zh: 小心不要在单行道逆向行驶。
ex.p: xiǎo xīn bù yào zài shàn xíng dào nì xiàng xíng shǐ
ex.en: Be careful not to drive the wrong way on a one-way street.

items.en: to commit an offense; to violate the law; excuse me! (formal)
to make heavier; to emphasize; (of an illness etc) to become more serious

ex.zh: 这位母亲偶尔会重温她的儿子的信件。
ex.p: zhè wèi mǔ qīn ǒu ěr huì zhòng wēn tā de ér zi de xìn jiàn
ex.en: The mother occasionally reread her son's letter.

ex.zh: 他扔了很多旧信件。
ex.p: tā rēng le hěn duō jiù xìn jiàn
ex.en: He threw away a bunch of old letters.

ex.zh: 形势似乎非常紧张严峻。
ex.p: xíng shì sì hū fēi cháng jǐn zhāng yán jùn
ex.en: The situation seemed very tense and dangerous.

items.en: frame (e.g. door frame); casing; fig. framework

ex.zh: 你很快就会习惯住在这里。
ex.p: nǐ hěn kuài jiù huì xí guàn zhù zài zhè lǐ
ex.en: You'll get used to living here in no time.

ex.zh: 你必须改掉这个坏习惯。
ex.p: nǐ bì xū gǎi diào zhè gè huài xí guàn
ex.en: You must get rid of that bad habit.

items.en: to investigate a crime; to scout; to reconnoiter
to sb's face; in sb's presence
to forecast; to predict; advance notice
to incline; to lean; to slant
deed; past achievement; important event of the past

贪.m: to have a voracious desire for

侦.m: as in 侦察 (to investigate a crime)

units.title: 晚间、黑白、物资
units.intro: HSK 7–9 · I, words 1641–1680, most common first. The sentences use characters from this unit and earlier ones, so each unit builds on the last. Finish the lessons, then pass the checkpoint (85%) to open the next unit.

items.en: black and white; right and wrong; monochrome

ex.zh: 那幅画是黑白的。
ex.p: nà fú huà shì hēi bái de
ex.en: The picture is in black and white.

items.en: time interval; work shift; time slot
signboard; shop sign; reputation of a business
so far; up to now; still (not)

ex.zh: 这部电影是我迄今为止看过的最好的一部。
ex.p: zhè bù diàn yǐng shì wǒ qì jīn wéi zhǐ kàn guò de zuì hǎo de yī bù
ex.en: This is the best movie I've ever seen.

ex.zh: 她一心一意地工作。
ex.p: tā yī xīn yī yì de gōng zuò
ex.en: She works with single-minded determination.

ex.zh: 你不能一心两用。
ex.p: nǐ bù néng yī xīn liǎng yòng
ex.en: You can't do two things at once.

ex.zh: 对于一个饥饿的人来说，任何食物都是美味。
ex.p: duì yú yī gè jī è de rén lái shuō rèn hé shí wù dōu shì měi wèi
ex.en: Hunger is the best sauce.

ex.zh: 世界上许多人很饥饿。
ex.p: shì jiè shǎng xǔ duō rén hěn jī è
ex.en: A lot of people are starving in the world.

ex.zh: 他被宣告破产。
ex.p: tā bèi xuān gào pò chǎn
ex.en: He was declared bankrupt.

ex.zh: 猫弓起背，伸了个懒腰。
ex.p: māo gōng qǐ bēi shēn le gè lǎn yāo
ex.en: The cat arched its back and stretched itself.

items.en: one head; a head full of sth; one end (of a stick)

ex.zh: 我有一头母牛。
ex.p: wǒ yǒu yī tóu mǔ niú
ex.en: I have a cow.

items.en: horn (automobile etc); loudspeaker; brass wind instrument
to show one's face; to appear (in public)

ex.zh: 汤姆不敢再到这里露面。
ex.p: tāng mǔ bù gǎn zài dào zhè lǐ lòu miàn
ex.en: Tom wouldn't dare show his face around here again.

items.en: in the dark; in secret; on the sly

ex.zh: 因为闪光灯坏了，他不能在黑暗中拍照。
ex.p: yīn wèi shǎn guāng dēng huài le tā bù néng zài hēi àn zhōng pāi zhào
ex.en: The flash wasn't working, so he couldn't take a picture in the dark.

items.en: to hold fast to; to stick to
artificial; man-made; having human cause or origin
to bother about; to haggle; to bicker

ex.zh: 如果你不计较太多，生活会更容易些。
ex.p: rú guǒ nǐ bù jì jiào tài duō shēng huó huì gēng róng yì xiē
ex.en: Life would be so much better if you didn't care so much.

ex.zh: 我们路上一帆风顺，直到遇上暴风雪。
ex.p: wǒ men lù shang yī fān fēng shùn zhí dào yù shàng bào fēng xuě
ex.en: We made good time until we ran into a blizzard.

ex.zh: 汤姆正在教我怎么开帆船。
ex.p: tāng mǔ zhèng zài jiāo wǒ zěn me kāi fān chuán
ex.en: Tom is teaching me to how to sail.

items.en: a bunch; to tie together; bundle
to sell; to peddle; to traffic

ex.zh: 汤姆说他是习惯的产物。
ex.p: tāng mǔ shuō tā shì xí guàn de chǎn wù
ex.en: Tom says that he's a creature of habit.

items.en: to switch off; to shut off

ex.zh: 喂，你能把灯关掉吗？
ex.p: wéi nǐ néng bǎ dēng guān diào ma
ex.en: Hey, can you turn the lights off?

ex.zh: 请把电视机关掉好吗？
ex.p: qǐng bǎ diàn shì jī guān diào hǎo ma
ex.en: Would you please turn off the TV?

items.en: slow and patient; chronic (disease); slow to take effect (e.g. a slow poison)

ex.zh: 我就要成为百万富翁了。
ex.p: wǒ jiù yào chéng wéi bǎi mò fù wēng le
ex.en: I'm going to be a millionaire.

items.en: to evaporate; (of cooking) to steam; torch made from hemp stalks or bamboo (old)
flowing (of speech, writing); fluent; smooth and easy

迄.m: as in 迄今为止 (so far)

units.title: 树木、崛起、点子
units.intro: HSK 7–9 · I, words 1681–1720, most common first. The sentences use characters from this unit and earlier ones, so each unit builds on the last. Finish the lessons, then pass the checkpoint (85%) to open the next unit.

ex.zh: 树木开始抽芽。
ex.p: shù mù kāi shǐ chōu yá
ex.en: The trees are beginning to bud.

items.en: to rise abruptly (to a towering position); to tower over; to spring up

ex.zh: 你鬼点子真多。
ex.p: nǐ guǐ diǎn zi zhēn duō
ex.en: You're very resourceful.

items.en: to overdo it; to overstep the limit; excessively

ex.zh: 汤姆睡过头了。
ex.p: tāng mǔ shuì guò tóu le
ex.en: Tom overslept.

ex.zh: 睡过头不是迟到的理由。
ex.p: shuì guò tóu bù shì chí dào de lǐ yóu
ex.en: Over-sleeping is no excuse for being late.

items.en: to draw towards oneself; to gather; to gather up (one's gown, sleeves etc)

ex.zh: 上个月我参加了三场葬礼。
ex.p: shàng gè yuè wǒ cān jiā le sān cháng zàng lǐ
ex.en: I went to three funerals last month.

ex.zh: 很多人都参加了他的葬礼。
ex.p: hěn duō rén dōu cān jiā le tā de zàng lǐ
ex.en: Many attended his funeral.

items.en: wrapping cloth; a bundle wrapped in cloth; load

ex.zh: 我想要点蛋糕。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng yào diǎn dàn gāo
ex.en: I want some cake.

ex.zh: 服务生，我要点菜。
ex.p: fú wù shēng wǒ yào diǎn cài
ex.en: Waiter, I'd like to order.

items.en: to hand in; to hand over; to seize

ex.zh: 所有美国人都需要缴税。
ex.p: suǒ yǒu měi guó rén dōu xū yào jiǎo shuì
ex.en: All Americans have to pay their taxes.

ex.zh: 老人咽下了最后一口气。
ex.p: lǎo rén yān xià le zuì hòu yī kǒu qì
ex.en: The old man breathed his last.

items.en: pigeon; dove; various birds of the family Columbidae

ex.zh: 为了不错过火车，他匆匆赶往了车站。
ex.p: wèi le bù cuò guò huǒ chē tā cōng cōng gǎn wǎng le chē zhàn
ex.en: He hurried to the station so he wouldn't miss the train.

ex.zh: 我匆匆忙忙，为的是能赶上第一班火车。
ex.p: wǒ cōng cōng máng máng wèi de shì néng gǎn shàng dì yī bān huǒ chē
ex.en: I hurried in order to catch the first train.

items.en: to search for; to look up

ex.zh: 我得查找一下我的笔。
ex.p: wǒ de chá zhǎo yī xià wǒ de bǐ
ex.en: I need to search for my pen.

ex.zh: 汤姆今天来得比往常要早一些。
ex.p: tāng mǔ jīn tiān lái de bǐ wǎng cháng yào zǎo yī xiē
ex.en: Tom came a little earlier today than he usually does.

ex.zh: 我和往常一样起得很早。
ex.p: wǒ hé wǎng cháng yī yàng qǐ de hěn zǎo
ex.en: I got up early as usual.

items.en: emergency relief; to help the needy with cash or goods

ex.zh: 她过去的生活仅够糊口。
ex.p: tā guò qù de shēng huó jǐn gòu hú kǒu
ex.en: She used to live hand to mouth.

ex.zh: 我对祖母的记忆很模糊。
ex.p: wǒ duì zǔ mǔ de jì yì hěn mó hu
ex.en: I have a dim memory of my grandmother.

items.en: racing bicycle; racing car; sports car

ex.zh: 汤姆有一辆黄色跑车。
